tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i zab khrid thun mong ma yin pa'i rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so//

rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi khrid kyi rim pa rnams dang las phran bu'i skor gyi gdams pa gcig tu dril ba dad ldan slob ma rnams kyi re skong yid bzhin rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro sems lha lam yangs pa'i mkha' dbyings su| |yan lag bdun ldan sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis// phan bde'i tsha zer bde stong spro mkhas pa// smra ba'i nyi ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud// des gsungs rtogs pa phul phyin sa ra ha// rang sems chos sku mngon gyur sha wa ri// nges don chos kun 'dzin mdzad seng ge'i mtshan// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de las rgyud lung gdams pa'i nges don dpyid// legs gsungs dal 'gro'i rgyun bzang gang bab pa| |rnam dpyod kyis 'dom snod ldan 'ga' zhig gi// re ba skong phyir snyan brgyud gdams pa rnams// yi ge'i lam du 'god la spro ba 'phel// zhes mchod par brjod pa dang brtsam par dam bca' ba sngon du btang nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bka' 'khor lo bar pa dang*/ tha ma nges don thams cad kyi snying po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen pos dpal sa ra ha la bshad cing*/ des sha wa ri dbang phyug la gdams pa chos thams cad kyi ma mo rtsa bar gyur pa zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang bla na med pa tshe 'di nyid kho na la tshegs chung ngus kyang thob par bya ba'i rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa dang las phran bu'i skor rnams bstan pa la/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos/ dang po brgyud pa'i rim pa la'ang*/ nye brgyud dang ring brgyud gnyis so// dang po ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'jigs med grags pa/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ shāka mi pham chos rje nam mkha' lhun grub/ dpal ldan bzang po/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ dbon po sangs rgyas dbon/

drung ras pa 'jam dbyangs dpal/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms phun tshogs/ des bdag chos kyi grags pa la dgyes bzhin du gnang ba'o| |gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po/ grub chen sa ra ha/ dpal sha wa ri dbang phyug /paṇḍi ta bi bhu ti tsand+ra/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bu ston rin chen grub/ lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo/ lo chen grags rgyal/ 'jigs med grags pa man gong dang 'dra'o// gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni gsum ste/ sbyor ba dpyid las dang 'dra ba brdar sha gcod pa'i khrid/ dngos gzhi dbyar las dang 'dra ba nyams su blang ba'i khrid/ mjug ston las dang 'dra ba 'bras bu bsdu ba'i khrid do// dang po sbyor ba dpyid las dang 'dra ba brdar sha gcod pa'i khrid ni/ tshe 'di la mngon par zhen pa'i gnyen por dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa/ snyoms las dang le lo'i gnyen por 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsam pa/ srid pa la bde ba'i gnyen por 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ dal 'byor gyi lus don yod par bya ba'i phyir las rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bsam pa rnams so// de rnams ni thun mong gi sngon 'gro'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi ni/ rgyud snod du rung bar sgrub pa skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi khrid/ sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal 'bul ba'i khrid/ rgyud la byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid rnams so// de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi ste/ sngon 'gro brgyad nyams su len dgos pa ni/ yun ring na zhag bcu drug dang*/ 'bring na zhag brgyad/ tha ma zhag bzhir sngon 'gro 'di rnams kyis rgyud legs par dul bar bya ba shin tu gal che ste/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ dngos gzhi las sngon 'gro zab par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbyar las dang 'dra ba nyams su blang ba'i khrid la/

thog mar sbyang ba rnam pa gsum dang*/ gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum dang*/ sgom pa rnam pa gsum las/ dang po sbyang ba rnam pa gsum ni/ dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las la sogs pa sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad 'bad rtsol med par rang sor bzhag par bya ste/ dper na chu dang sa dang 'dra bar lus ngag yid gsum dwangs pa'i dgos pa yod do// gnyis pa gnad la dbab pa rnam pa gsum ni/ lus gnad la dbab pa'i phyir rkang pa sems dpa'i skyil krung ngam tsog pur g.yas phyir byas nas bsnol ba gang bder skyil krung ltar na lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur pus steng brgyang lus bsrang*/ tsog pu ltar na rkang gnyis bsnol ba re'u mig lta bu'i tshul gyis 'phongs kyi gnag po che dang rkang pa gnyis dang gsum sgyed puu btsugs pa ltar bya lag pa sgom thag gi phyag rgya'am thab 'gel gyi phyag rgya bya/ lus gnad de gnyis gang byed kyang mgo cung zad sgur/ mig sna rtser phab/ lce ya rkan la sbyar/ so dang mchu mnyam por bya/ de dag kyang na so gzhon pa dang*/ nam zla ston dpyid dang*/ nad khrag mkhris dang*/ drod dang tsha ba shas che na dus thams cad du lus gnad skyil krung legs shing*/ na so rgan pa dang*/ nam zla dgun dang*/ nad rlung dang bad kan shas che ba dang*/ grang shas che na dus thams cad du lus gnad tsog pu la bslab par bya'o// lus gnad de gnyis gang byed kyang*/ bcas zin nas sna sgo nas rlung drag tu phyir bus la rlung rtsol med du bzhag cing*/ ngag long gtam mi bya/ sems dar cig glod la 'jog pa rnams ni lus ngag yid gsum gnad la dbab pa yin no// gsum pa sgom pa rnam pa gsum ni/ dang po bsags pa'i las thams cad gzhan don du bsgyur ba'i phyir theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo 'di bdag cag gis ci nas kyang nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed do// gnyis pa bla ma bsgom pa ni/

tshogs rdzogs pa'i yan lag ni/ rang lus tha mal pa'i spyi bor gyad dang seng ges bteg pa'i khri'i steng du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ longs sku nges pa lnga ldan gyi nyams dang ldan pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba/ de la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par mos la/ mos gus kyi dad pa kha tsam tshig tsam min pa snying gi nang*/ rkang gi khong*/ rus pa'i gting*/ zhe thag pa nas 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab bo// mi 'gyur drug ldan rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du mer gyis zhu nas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas brgyud de lus thams cad 'od zer sna lngas mer gyis gang bas rang lus kyi phyi nang gi rtsa 'khums pa dang*/ bskams pa dang*/ zha ba dang*/ 'chus pa dang*/ 'khyogs pa dang*| yo ba dang*/ zhar ba la sogs pa'i nyes skyon thams cad med par byas shing lam 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la bar du gcod pa'i 'gal rkyen thams cad bsal nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya bar mos pa'i ngang nas dar cig mnyam par bzhag go// gsum pa tha mal gyi rtog pa spang phyir yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags brjod pa tsam gyis sa 'og /sa steng*/ sa bla'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha dang lha mor gsal btab ste de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// de rnams ni khyad par can gyi sngon du 'gro ba'o// lam gyi dngos gzhi la'ang thog mar sor sdud dang bsam gtan gnyis bsgom pa ni/

sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa 'di yul so so la yengs shing*/ 'jug pa dang*/ 'khyams pa dang*/ 'gyur ba mang po 'di rnams rtse gcig tu rang gi sems la bsdus te gang du'ang ma yeng bar 'gyur ba bzang ngan gang yang med par ci gnas kyi ngang mnyam par bzhag cing*/ de las 'phro na 'gyu ba bzang ngan gang gis kyang bar ma chod pa nas sems can thams cad kyi don du lam zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blangs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la sems can thams cad kyi don bya'o snyam du drag la yun ring du bsgom par bya'o// dngos gzhi la/ sku rdo rje'i khrid/ gsung rdo rje'i khrid/ thugs rdo rje'i khrid dang gsum las/ dang po sku rdo rje'i khrid ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ sgo gsum dag par byed pa rdo rje 'chang*// dngos grub stsol mdzad bla ma rin po che// sngags rnams kun gyi snying po 'bru gsum pa// lam zab chu rgyun gcig pas 'dir 'bad bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur/ oṃ gzugs thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo ste/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang grub par gyur/ āḥsgra thams cad kyi ngo bo 'od dpag med kyi ngo bo ste/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i padma dang zla ba'i gdan grub par gyur/ hūm̐ rang gi sems nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum de'ang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig |phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa dang rdo rje padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/

de'i spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum sku rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam par gyur par mos la/ phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi mchod pa ji ltar 'byor bas mchod la/ de lta bu'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o// bzlas pas skyo na/ dbang blang ba'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bsdus/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag /lam tshogs lam bsgom pa la dbang*// dkar lam gyi snang ba mngon du byas/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje'i go 'phang thob/ yang gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros| phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag /lam sbyor lam bsgom pa la dbang*/

dmar lam gyi snang ba mngon du byas/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje'i go 'phang thob| yang gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lte ba yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor yid kyi dri ma dag /lam mthong lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ nag lam gyi snang ba mngon du byas/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje'i go 'phang thob/ bzhi pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che bdag sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya bar spros bral gyi gsung thos shing*/ gnyis med kyi thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs dgyes bzhin pa'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas de ltar bya'o gsungs nas/ bla ma yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang yang 'od du zhu nas tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam sgom lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i go 'phang thob par bsam/ mthar gang yang mi sems par gzhi med rtsa bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa ni sku rdo rje'i khrid ces bya'o// gnyis pa gsung rdo rje'i khrid la sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ rtsa'i stong ra dang rlung gi stong ra gnyis las/ thog mar rtsa'i stong ra rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ lus gnad rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas la/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang phyi gsal nang gsal du bsgoms pa'i nang du spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma chu shing ltar drang ba/ padma'i snal ma ltar phra ba/ rgya skyegs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba/ shel gyi gong bu ltar gsal ba ste/

chos bzhi ldan de lta bur gsal btab bo// gnyis pa rlung gi stong ra rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa gong ltar la rang gi dbugs kyi rlung 'di yar 'jug pa oṃ dang*/ nang du gnas pa āḥ phyir dbyung ba hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du bsgom par bya'o// de ni sngon du 'gro ba dag go// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ 'jam rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ bar rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ drag rlung rdo rje'i bzlas pa gsum las/ dang po 'jam rlung rdor bzlas ni/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ srog rtsol sgo ru 'od gsal bzung*// 'gyu ba rlung gi de nyid shes| |rlung gi kha dog mthong bar 'gyur// bcu gnyis bcu drug bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga bcu drug phyi ru rgyu// phyi 'phel nang du thung ngur 'gyur// dhū ti'i nang du 'od gsal bzung*// rtog med sems kyi de nyid shes// zhes pa ni/ sa rlung thur la/ chu rlung ka ba la/ me rlung mkhur ba la/ rlung gi rlung stod la/ nam mkha'i rlung dbus nas rgyu'o// de ni/ srog rtsol rlung gi de nyid shes// zhes pa'i don no// rlung gi kha dog mthong bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ni/ chu rlung sngon po/ sa rlung ser po/ me rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung ljang gu/ nam mkha'i rlung nag po ste sgra gcan no// bcu gnyis bcu gsum bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga bcu drug phyi ru rgyu// zhes pa ni/ sa rlung sor bcu gnyis/ chu rlung sor bcu gsum/ me rlung sor bcu bzhi/ rlung gi rlung sor bco lnga*/ nam mkha'i rlung sor bcu drug go// phyi 'phel nang du thung ngur 'gyur// zhes pa ni/ sa rlung gsang gnas su/ de'i gong du chu rlung*/ de'i gong du me rlung*/ de'i 'og tu rlung gi rlung*/ de'i 'og tu nam mkha'i rlung ngo*// de'i nang du 'jug pa dang mnyam po yin la/ phyi la 'gro dus sa rlung lte ba gzhan rnams kyi phyi 'phel lo// dhū ti'i nang du 'od gsal gzung*/

zhes pa ni/ thog mar rtags bcu'i 'od gsal 'char zhing de la brten nas thams cad rtog pa'i 'od gsal rtog med chos sku mngon du 'gyur/ zhes pa'o// gnyis pa bar rlung rdor bzlas la gsum ste/ pho rlung rdor bzlas/ mo rlung rdor bzlas/ ma ning rlung rdor bzlas dang gsum mo// dang po pho rlung rdor bzlas ni/ rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud las/ rtsa ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa// rlung ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa// thig le rdo rje rtse lnga pa// rtsa ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud// rlung gi rdo rje lu gu rgyud// thig le rdo rje lu gu rgyud// ces bshad pas/ lus rdo rje rtse lnga pa ni/ mgo bo dang lag pa gnyis dang gsum rkang pa gnyis dang lnga'o// rtsa rdo rje rtse lnga pa ni/ dbu ma rtse lnga pa yar sne spyi bo la zug pa haṃ yig gis bkag pa/ mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa la a shad kyis bkag pa/ bdag gis pho rlung nang du kha sbyor bzung bas haṃ zhu nas thig le dkar por gyur pa mar bab ste/ dbu mar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte ba nas bskor bar byed pa rgyab 'then/ mdun phur bas a shad yar 'ong thig le dmar por gyur nas thig le dkar dmar 'bros 'ded byed par bsam zhing*/ lte ba la rdo rje khu tshur gyis mnan pas thig le dkar po dang dkar cha sogs pho rlung thams cad mar gyi rdo rje'i rwa lnga la thim/ thig le dmar po sogs dmar cha dang me rlung thams cad yar gyi rdo rje'i rwa lnga la thim zhing dbu ma'i yar sne lnga rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lnga dang mar sne lnga rdo rje 'chang lnga ru gsal btab nas/ pho ba la khu tshur bsnun pas dkar cha thams cad yar 'ongs te rnal 'byor ma lnga la mchod pa phul/ dmar cha thams cad mar bab ste rdo rje 'chang lnga la mchod pa phul bar bsams la yun ring du bsgom/ mthar lha dang rtsa thams cad mi dmigs pa'i ngang du rgyas gdab bo// gnyis pa mo rlung rdor bzlas ni/ gzhi lus gong ltar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo la nang dmar ba yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa/

dkar cha'i dwangs ma haṃ yig dkar zhing 'tsher ba mgo thur bstan gyis bkag pa/ mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa dmar cha'i dwangs ma a shad shin tu dmar zhing bde ba dang rtse mo gyen du phyogs pas bkag pa/ snying gi thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ rlung ro bus nas yar ma brngub par mo rlung phyi 'dzin byas pas ya ga'i haṃ yig zhu ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur te mar bab/ ma ga'i a shad zhu ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tu gyur te yar byung ba nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūm̐ la shes pa ma yeng bar gtad de phyag rgya gong mdzub snying khar gtad do// gsum pa ma ning gi rlung rdor bzlas ni/ gzhi lus gong bu'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne spyi bor zug pa| mar sne gsang gnas chos 'byung dmar po yod pa'i nang du zug pa'i dbu ma'i mar sne chos 'byung gi dbus su rang gi sems a yig dkar po nas 'bru tsam la sems gtad de/ ma ning gi rlung phyi nang gang du'ang mi 'dzin par rang bab la 'jog pa yin no// gsum pa drag rlung rdor bzlas ni/ rtsa 'dab gsum ste/ rtsa'i rtsa 'dab/ rlung gi rtsa 'dab/ thig le'i rtsa 'dab dang gsum ste/ kyai rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa las/ rtsa'i rtsa 'dab rlung gi rtsa 'dab dang*// thig le'i rtsa 'dab dag gis ni// 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur| |zhes dang*/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ rtsa yi 'khor lo 'khor lo yis// g.yo ba rdo rje dgag par bya// rlung gi 'khor lo 'khor lo yis// g.yo ba rdo rje dgag par bya// thig le'i 'khor lo 'khor lo yis// g.yo ba rdo rje dgag par bya// zhes gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po rtsa'i rtsa 'dab la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la'ang*| lus 'dul/ yan lag lnga sbyong*/ mtsho bskyod pa/ srub cing bsrub pa/ bsad pa nor lha bcu drug

/rdo rje 'chang phyi'i chig rdzogs/ nang gi chig rdzogs/ gsang ba'i chig rdzogs te 'khrul 'khor brgyad yod pa la/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad/ bzung ba rlung gi gnad/ dmigs pa yul gyi gnad dang gsum gsum gyi sgo nas bya dgos pa'i dang po lus 'dul ni/ sems skyil lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur pus steng brgyangs la/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mos sna bug g.yas bkag ste/ g.yon nas rlung ro gsum 'bud/ yang g.yon pa'i mdzub mos sna bug g.yon bkag ste| g.yas nas rlung ro gsum 'bud/ slar yang lag gnyis khu tshur pus steng bzhag la/ sna bug gnyis ka nas lan gsum 'bud do// de ni rlung 'bud pa dgu phrugs te snod bkru bshal byas pa dang 'dra ste/ 'khrul 'khor thams cad kyi sngon du 'di nyid gal che'o// de tshur khengs par brngubs te mchil ma zhig dang lhan cig tu lte 'og mid la hril gyis mnan/ rgyab rlung bsdams te bum pa can du byas la cung zad dgang nas gzhil/ de nas khu tshur gnyis gzhog drud nu steng rdeg pa dang mdun du brgyang ba gsum bya/ de nas lag pa g.yas kyis g.yon sbreng ba lan gsum bshud/ g.yas la'ang de 'dra ba gsum bya/ de nas lag g.yas steng dang g.yon 'og tu kha sbubs la phyir bkan te/ de nas lag gnyis bsnol mar brang lan gsum bshud/ de bzhin du lan gsum bshud/ mdun rgyab dang mchan khung yar mar lan gsum bshud pa 'di rnams rdo rje khu tshur gyis bshud/ de nas rkang pa g.yas sgreng ba dang lhan cig lag gnyis rdo rje'i khu tshur pus mo phan tshun du brgyangs nas slar rdo rje'i khu tshur bshig nas rkang pa lan gsum bshud/ rkang pa g.yon pa'ang de bzhin du bya/ de nas lus gnad kyi steng nas dal bus sna nas btang ngo*// gnyis pa yan lag lnga sbyong ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung mgo bo g.yas skor g.yon skor gsum dang*/ mgo bo g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu bcag pa gsum gsum bya/

de nas pus btsugs rkang mthil gnyis rgyab tu bsnol/ lag g.yon khu tshur pus dkur brten nas lag pa g.yas kyis dpung bteg dang g.yon gyis gsum mnyam du gsum bya/ yang g.yas kyis zhags skyur gsum dang g.yon gyis gsum mnyam du gsum bya/ lus gnad steng nas rlung btang ngo*// gsum pa mtsho bskyod pa ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung*/ pho ba g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum bya/ de nas lag g.yon khu tshur brla khug tu bzhag la g.yas khu tshur gzhog drud mchan rdeb mdun brgyang zhing nu khar rdeg pa gsum bya/ yang phyag rgya de bsgyur ba g.yon du gsum mnyam du gsum bya/ lus gnad steng nas rlung btang ngo*// bzhi pa srub cing bsrub pa ni/ lus gnad steng rlung bzung*/ lag g.yon khu tshur pus steng brgyang*/ lag g.yas khu tshur dpung pa dang bcas pa yar 'then la khu tshur bshad cing mar lhod po pus mo las mi 'da' bar gtong ba gsum bya/ de'i rjes khu tshur gnyis pus steng brgyangs la g.yon du gcu zhing gzhil/ g.yon la'ang de 'dra ba gsum byas la mnyam du gsum bya zhing lus gnad steng nas rlung btang ngo*// lnga pa bsad pa nor lha bcu drug ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung la tsog pu pus 'khyud bya/ dpung pa gnyis mnyam du g.yas skor g.yon skor gsum bya/ de nas dpung pa gnyis res mos nas mdun pus mos mthud nas phyi ngos su ltag 'then gnyis re bya/ de nas sked pa phyir sgur ba dang*/ pus mo kha bskyed nas bkan pa gnyis bya/ de nas dpung pa gnyis yar 'then la lhod kyis glod la 'bebs bya ba gnyis kyis so| |drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi phyi'i chig rdzogs ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung pus mo gnyis btsugs te langs/ lag gnyis khu tshur dang gzhog drud mchan rdeb spyi bo'i thad kyi nam mkhar gcu ba gsum dang*/ slar lag pa bskums pa'i khu tshur gnyis snying khar bsnol te cung zad bsdad/

slar yang lag pa brkyangs shing pus btsugs dang*/ lag pa snying khar bsnol te 'bebs rgyag pa gsum bya/ lus gnad kyi steng nas rlung btang ngo*// dmigs pa ni/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa'i yar sne a shad gsal btab la 'khrul 'khor rgyab pa'i yar pus mo btsugs dus ma ga'i byang sems dmar po yar drangs spyi bo'i haṃ la thim zhing*/ mar 'bebs rgyag dus rang lus rtsa dang bcas pa thams cad 'ja' lus su phung phung song bar bsam mo// bdun pa rdo rje 'chang nang gi chig rdzogs ni/ lus gnad sems skyil rlung bzung la gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal btab la/ nang du rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo la nang dmar ba dang*/ g.yas su rkyang ma dkar po dang*/ g.yon du ro ma dmar po gsal btab la/ lag gnyis khu tshur gzhog drud g.yas ngos su brkyangs shing nu khar rdeg pa gsum dang*/ khu tshur pus steng bzhag la g.yas su gzhil/ de nas khu tshur gnyis dpyi zur du brgyangs la 'bebs gsum rgyag /de bzhin du g.yon du brgyangs shing brdegs la/ g.yon du gzhil ba'i 'bebs gsum dang dbus su rdeg cing g.yas g.yon gnyis kar gzhil ba'i 'bebs gsum rnams brgyab pas/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis ka'i byang sems dkar dmar thams cad dbu ma'i nang du zhugs shing 'dres nas bde stong gi nyams khyad par can dpag tu med pa skyes par bsam mo// rlung gtong ba'i tshe rkang lag thams cad sprug cing ha zhes brjod la drag tu sprug go// brgyad pa rdo rje 'chang gsang ba'i chig rdzogs ni/ lus gnad steng rlung bzung*/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal btab pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma dmigs la rkang pa gnyis bsnol te/ tsog pu'i re'u mig byas pa'i lag gnyis dam pa'i phyag rgya nu ma'i thad du bca'/ de nas pus btsugs langs te lag gnyis khu tshur gzhog drud mchan rdeb nam mkhar brgyangs la khu tshur gzhibs te g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus rnams su gcu ba re re dang chun bcug

/de nas lag gnyis g.yas g.yon du brgyangs la yud tsam bsdad/ slar khu tshur snying khar bsnol la sa la bsdad nas lta stangs la 'jog/ de nas khu tshur gnyis dpyi zur du brgyangs la 'bebs gsum dang rlung gtong ba'i tshe ha sprug byas la btang ngo*// de dag ni sngon 'gro'i 'khrul 'khor brgyad do// gnyis pa rtsa'i rtsa 'dab kyi dngos gzhi la/ smin byed kyi dbang dang*/ grol byed kyi gdams pa gnyis so// dang po smin byed kyi dbang ni/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang gi dbus su rtsa dbu ma sngon po yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ yar sne tshangs bug nas mdzub gang tsam don pa'i rtse mor rdo rje 'chang sngon po gcig gsal/ g.yon du ro ma dmar po'i rtse mor rdo rje 'chang dmar po gcig bsam/ g.yas su rkyang ma dkar po'i rtse mor rdo rje 'chang dkar po gcig bsam mo| |de la maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje 'chang dkar po 'od du zhu nas rkyang ma la thim zhing rkyang ma ro ma la thim pas bum dbang thob/ rdo rje 'chang dmar po 'od du zhu nas ro ma la thim zhing ro ma dbu ma la thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po 'od du zhu nas dbu ma la thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtsa dbu ma 'ja' 'od du phung gis yal nas lus kyi khog smad zom stong du yod pa'i dkyil du āḥdakar po gcig yod par bsams pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i dbang bzhi pa thob/ āḥyig kyang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas gang du yang mi sems par rang babs su lhod de 'jog pa ni mtshan ma med pa'i dbang bzhi pa yin par go bar bya'o// gnyis pa grol byed gdams pa ni/ dbang mdor bstan las/ srog rtsol la brten lba ba sbubs su nub// rtsa chu bsdam zhing sbos la tsheg tsheg rab tu 'byung*// rlung sems nor bur brtan pas spyi bo za zhing 'bur// nor bu 'gags pa gtsug tor 'khor lor 'gyur| |zhes gsungs/

dngos gzhi rdo rje sbubs 'dren la/ 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rlung rtsol dmigs pa'o// 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur pus steng bzhag |'di la nang 'dzin sbubs 'dren dkyus la lnga dang*/ phyi 'dzin sbubs 'dren thun mong ba gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa yang shes zab mo'i lus gnad gcig rnams yod pa las/ sbubs 'dren nang 'dzin rnams kyi lus gnad pho rlung dgang dril lus thams cad 'dra'o// nang 'dzin sbubs 'dren dkyus la/ dang po rlung bzung la rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mdun du brgyangs la nor bu 'then/ gnyis pa khu tshur pus steng brgyangs la 'then no// gsum pa lag gnyis bsnol te dpung pa gnyis la 'jus 'then no// bzhi pa lag gnyis bsnol te pus mo gnyis nas 'then zhing 'then no// lnga pa g.yon khu tshur pus steng brgyang lag g.yas khu tshur pho ba la bsnun cing 'then no// phyi 'dzin thun mong ba'i sbubs 'dren gsum gyi dang po la/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis khu tshur pus steng brgyangs la hūm̐ zhes drangs/ gnyis pa la lag gnyis bsnol mar dpung pa gnyis la 'jus nas hūm̐ zhes 'then no// gsum pa lag gnyis khu tshur pus steng brgyangs la hūm̐ mi brjod par phyir bus la nang du mi brngub par phyi 'dzin byas la 'then no// yang shes zab mo'i lus gnad gcig ni/ rlung bzung la lag g.yon gyi 'chang par rdo rje bcug pa'i kha nas mdzub mos nang du bsgyur zhing lag g.yas khu tshur mdun du brgyangs te 'then no// 'di rnams kyi tshe mdun phul/ rkub phyi la phul/ sked pa nyag /lkog ma brang la sbyar/ ltag pa bsrang zhing chun bcug la 'then no// sbubs 'dren de thams cad kyi dmigs pa ni/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du dbu ma sngon po yar sne spyi bo la zug pa'i steng du rdo rje 'chang sngon po/ phyag na gser gyi nyag thag la dngul gyi rdo rje lcags kyu yod pa dbu ma'i nang du mar btang nas/

lcags kyu des rdo rje la brgyab nas 'then pas gos kyi phu dung phyi nang slog pa ltar nyer nyer nang du song nas dbu ma'i lam la brgyud de/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga'i nang nas gtsug tor nor bur gyur nas rgyangs rgyangs thon par bsams la drag tu 'then no// de'i don yang*/ dbang mdor bstan las/ nyi zla'i 'khrul 'khor gyis drangs shing*// dam tshig rgya mtsho'i steng du 'phang*// khro gnyer rim par ldan la sogs// spyi bo'i gtsug tu son par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don te/ de ltar lba ba sbubs su drangs pas gnas skabs su thur sel dbang du 'du ba dang nor bu las su rung ba sogs 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug bskal pa mang por 'tshang rgya bar bsgug mi dgos par/ da lta nyid du lba ba sbubs su sbas te spyi bor bton nas gtsug tor grub par byas nas 'tshang rgya ba la tshegs med pa'i phyir ro// de rnams kyi rim pa rtsa 'dab rim pa dag go| |gnyis pa rlung gi rtsa 'dab la'ang rgyab rlung dang mdun rlung gnyis so// dang po rgyab rlung 'tsho ba'i rim pa'ang*/ dbang mdor bstan las/ nyi ma zla ba'i rtsa 'gags nas// bshang ba gci ba'i rtsa 'gag go// sgra gcan gyi ni rtsa 'gags na// 'og tu khu ba 'bab pa 'gag /skyed dang sdud pa'i byed pa mo// 'di rnams grol na grol bar 'gyur// srog dang thur sel lam gsum gyi// 'di ni rtsa yi kun spyod do// zhes dang*/ dus 'khor las/ thur du rgyu ba kun nas bskums byas na// lus mchog rlung rnams ma lus rab tu 'joms// zhes dang*/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las/ thur du rgyu ba srog dang bsdongs nas dbu mar rab tu 'jug pa la// dbyug pa'i gzugs can dgang zhing gzer la tsheg tsheg rab tu 'bar// zhes gsungs pas/ dang po rgyab rlung sbyang ba ni/ rgyud las/ 'phongs tshos bteg /sor mos bskyod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ dang po kha zas rags pa thams cad 'khri ba rbad kyis bcad la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang gis smin par byas nas thog mar rlung brdzang ba ni/

rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma kha dog ser po smyug mdong tsam pa yar sne lce chung dang mar sne 'og sgor zug par bsam/ rlung yar brdzangs mar bus pa'i dus thig le ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam zhig rlung mar bus dus mar rgyangs kyis don zhing yar 'then dus yar rgyangs rgyangs thon par bsams la/ lus gnad 'phongs bteg phyi rting gis bteg /rkang pa'i brang sa la phab lus bsgur ba'i brang pus mo la bkal/ lag pa gnyis kyi sor mor bi ṭa'i kha gdangs la rlung ro phyir bus/ nang du ma brngub pa'i mod la dbu ma ka ba gcig pas btsugs la yar 'then zhing sked pa nyag nyag byas la/ yang sbyangs pas 'og sgo nas rlung hog sgra dang bcas nas 'jug go// de nas rlung 'tsho ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rang lus dang dbu ma gong ltar la/ dbu ma'i nang snying ga'i thad du rdo rje 'chang sngon po tshon gang ba zhig bsgom/ dbu ma'i mar sne bshang sgor rlung gi lha mo sngo ljang phyag gnyis thod pa rlung kha dog lnga ldan gyis bkang ba bsnams pa zhig gsal btab la/ rlung 'og sgo nas rdzong ba'i tshe lha mo'i phyag gi thod pa'i nang gi rlung de rnams rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa phul bas sib sib thim par bsams la 'bad do// 'di dus khong par rnam snang yod na na zug 'byung bas phyir 'don dgos pas/ thun mong ba zag pa dang khong pa'i nad thams cad phyir 'don pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje lus kyi rtsa mdud grol nas 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i thabs ston pa'i 'khrul 'khor kun rdzogs la 'bad dgos pas/ dang po 'bebs khung ni| sa khad snyoms par rgyar khru gang dang*/ zabs su rkang gang pa gru bzhi par brus pa'i steng du/ 'bebs stan rgyar bskums khru gang pa dang*/ dpangs sor mo bdun pa/ gla lpags sogs la bcos pa'i nang gla ba'i spus brgyangs pa bzhag la/ rang nyid kyis rlung steng gi sna nas brngubs shing 'og sgo nas kyang mang du brdzangs la chu bskol mang du btung ste kun rdzogs thams cad kyi dus dmigs pa ni/

gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du/ rtsa dbu ma smyug mdong tsam pa ser po/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne 'og sgor zug pa'i nang du gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig yod pa de yar lang dus tshangs bug mar 'bebs rgyag dus 'og sgor rgyangs rgyangs thon par bsam mo// kun rdzogs kyi dang po lus 'dul ni/ 'bebs khung steng byams bzhugs byas la steng 'og gi rlung bcug la rdo rje khu tshur pus steng bzhag la langs pa dang lhan cig khu tshur gzhog drud mchan rdeb mdun du brgyangs la nu khar rdeg cing slar yang sor mos brla gnyis bshad cing 'then rgyag pa bcu tsam bya'o// dngos gzhi 'bebs chen rnams kyi dmigs pa dang rlung rtsol sngar ltar la/ dang po shākya thub pa'i gtsug tor ni/ lag gnyis spyi bor kha spubs pa'i gung mo gnyis lto sprad la bsgreng*/ sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol te bkab la 'bebs rgyag go// gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya ni/ lang ba'i dus khu tshur mchan rdeb mdun du brgyang zhing nu khar bsnol te rdeg pa dang lhan cig 'bebs so// gsum pa tilli'i til rdung ni/ khu tshur gnyis dpyi zur du thur du brgyangs la 'bebs so// bzhi pa nā ro'i sdigs mdzub ni/ khu tshur mdun du brgyangs nas sdigs mdzub dang slar nang du bskums nas lag pa ma bsnol bar nu khar rdeg cing 'bebs so// lnga pa mar pa'i rgod gshog ni/ lag gnyis g.yas g.yon khu tshur thad du rab tu brgyangs nas 'bebs so// drug pa mi la ras pa'i thags gcod ni/ lag gnyis khu tshur skra mtshams su khyer nas thags gcod pa ltar 'bebs so// bdun pa gling ras kyi rdo gcog ni/ khu tshur gnyis bsnol bas pho bar rdeg cing 'bebs rgyag go// brgyad pa 'bebs chen ni/ lang ba'i tshe khu tshur gzhog drud gnam du brgyangs shing sor mo sgreng bcag ni mchan brdabs shing 'bebs rgyag pa rnams so// de ltar rlung rtsol dang*/

'khrul 'khor dmigs pa dang*/ chu bskol btung ba la 'bad cing sbyangs pas na zug dang bcas te zag pa thams cad thon yong zhing zag pa gtan nas ma lus pa zhig gal che/ zag pa lus na nad du 'gyur ro// zag pa med pa'i tshe kha nas chu bskol btung ba de rkub nas sngo sang sang ma thon bar du 'bebs dang rlung rtsol bya'o// 'di 'byongs nas 'og rlung steng du bsre ba ni/ lus gnad khyung gi 'dug stangs te/ sems skyil puus mo rong byas pa'i pus mgo la lag mthil bkab nas 'og rlung tshad med pa brdzangs te pho stod du ldir bas/ sgregs pa mang la che ba kha nas yar rlung e thon blta zhing dmigs/ gzhi lus dang dbu ma rdo rje 'chang dang bcas pa sngar ltar gsal btab la/ rlung yar rdzong dus ma ga'i lha mo yar rdo rje 'chang la sib sib thim par bsams la steng rlung 'og dang 'og rlung steng du ma thon bar du sbyang ngo*// de nas rlung la rang dbang thob nas bya rgod kyi sgro rkang brdar/ gad legs par byas pa la mar khu cung zad byugs pa 'og sgor rang gi mkhyid gang bcug ste lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lus mchu dang rang gi lus drod dang mnyam pa drangs la pho skor 'bebs dang bcas pas phyir 'bud/ de rjes chang skyur dang bul tog btab la drang ba sogs mang du bya/ de rjes rang rang la nad ro gang yod kyi bshal sman chu la btab ste drang ba yang sngar bzhin bya'o// de nas zas snyigs dang nad thams cad phyir thon te gtsang sang nge song ba dang*/ sha dang mar sogs bcud sna tshogs bsres pa'i thug pa grang dro rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam pa rgod rkang gis drangs te 'drongs nas mal sar dal bus bsdad cing gal te bcud mi sdod na bshang lam gyen log gi 'dug stangs byas pas bcud 'tsho'o// yang 'brug rus padma rakta ga pur rnams sbyar ba'i chu rgyab mdun gyi 'og sgo bcud gang mi 'tsho ba'i phyogs der drangs des 'tsho'o// bcud 'dren dus dmigs pa ni/

gzhi lus sngar ltar la dbu ma'i yar sne spyi bo dang*| mar sne 'og sgo la zug pa'i spyi bor rdo rje 'chang dkar po/ mgrin par dmar po/ snying gar sngon po/ lte ba'i thad du rdo rje 'chang dbus su sngon po/ shar du dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du sngon po rnams bsgom/ dbu ma'i mar sner lha mo sngon mo bcud kyis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa zhig gsal btab la rang gis bcud 'dren dus thog mar ka 'dzugs| dang po lte ba'i rdo rje 'chang lnga la mchod pa phul/ gnyis pa snying kha'i rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa phul/ gsum pa mgrin pa'i rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa phul/ bzhi pa spyi bo'i rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa phul/ ka 'dzugs lnga pas stod kyi rdo rje 'chang rnams snying ga'i rdo rje 'chang la thim/ smad kyi rdo rje 'chang dang lha mo'ang snying khar thim/ snying gi rdo rje 'chang dbu mar thim/ dbu ma rang lus la thim/ rang lus kyang gzha' tshon du yal bar dmigs la phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go// de nas rjes srog thur bsre ba ni/ lus gnad gyad kyi 'dug stangs gsum las/ dang po lag pa'i khu tshur mdun du brgyangs la kha sbub 'phongs tshos rting bteg nas dang*/ gnyis pa lus cung zad sgur zhing lag gnyis pus mo la bkab/ gsum pa lag pa'i sor mos srin zhal kha cung zad phye nas sgur la bya'o// lus gnad de gsum ga'i rlung gnad ni 'og rlung brdzangs la kha nas 'don zhing yar sne nas rlung brngubs la thams cad rkub nas 'don thub pa/ don du srog rlung sna nas brngubs pa 'og sgor thon pa/ thur sel 'og sgo nas brngubs pa kha nas 'don pa la mi thogs pa zhig la bslab par bya'o// de nas cung mar zag ma byung tshe thog mar kha dang rkub gnyis ka nas thug pa drangs/ de kha nas thug pa 'thung zhing rjes su kha zas rags pa nyung nyung nas mus kyis goms par byas la shin tu stabs gzab par bya'i/

de lta min na 'di shin tu nyen che bas srog 'dor ba'i gnad du 'gro ba ni gegs so// de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa ni gnas skabs su nad thon pa dang*/ kha zas rags pa'i 'khri ba chod pa dang*/ srog thur dbang du 'du ba dang*/ thur sel gyen du 'drong bar 'gyur la/ mthar thug tha mal gyi lus mi 'jog par 'ja' lus tshe 'di nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang dngos su thob pa la tshegs med pa'i phyir/ de dag gi lag len zhib pa ni bla ma'i zhal shes dang man ngag mthong ba rgyud pa ltar bya ba dag ste/ des ni rgyab rlung rlung 'tsho'i rim pa zhib cing tshang ba ma nor ba bstan zin to// gnyis pa mdun rlung chu 'thung dkar dmar 'thung ba'i man ngag gdams pa la/ sbyang ba dang gnad la dbab pa gnyis las/ dang po sbyang ba ni/ dbang mdor bstan las| srin po rab 'jigs rgya mtsho rngub// ces dang*/ 'phongs tshos rting bteg sor mos bskyod// dbang po'i mchog gnyis gyen la bgrad// ba yi 'o ma 'thung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang dbang mdor bstan las/ rdo rje khrag 'thung rgyal po yi// he ru ka ni khrag 'thung 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ lus gnad sems skyil byas la/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma dmar po yar sne spyi bo dang*/ mar sne gnyis su gyes pa'i gcig 'og sgo dang gcig rdo rje'i rtse la zug par bsams la/ rdo rje lus 'dul ni/ mi'i klad pa dang mi grir shi ba'i rus pa dang mar bsres la rdo rje la byugs te yun ring du lag pas mnye'o// de nas 'dre rdo nag ril rdog gcig la mar byugs la rdo rje'i sbubs su bcug la yar shad mar shad yun ring du bya/ de 'byongs nas gro sog sbu gu bcug la khas len phus 'debs shing dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyis drangs/ de 'byongs pa'i rtags rdo rje'i kha nas lbu ba rtsi rtsi 'byung*/ rlung 'jug pa shin tu dka' na rgyab rlung ran tsam brdzangs nas bskyil/

srog rlung drag tu mnan la drangs/ 'byongs nas rgyab rlung 'jug mi dgos so// de nas pi pi'i kha la lgang phu bskyon nang phus bkang la pi pi rdo rje'i khung du bcug la rang gi ka 'dzugs kyis drangs shing lag pas lgang phu btsir la phu nang du 'gro ba de 'dra lan mang du bya'o// de 'byongs pa'i rtags ni lag pas lgang phu btsir mi dgos par ka 'dzugs byas pa tsam gyis lgang phu nang gi rlung 'jug par 'gyur ro// de nas rdo rje'i dbugs skor ni/ slar yang pi pi bcug la rang gi dbu mas drangs shing phyi'i sne nas rang gi kha'i phus btab la sbyang ngo*// de nas rdo rje'i dbugs 'thum ni/ pi pi'i sne la lgang phu skyi dkar gyi zha mos g.yogs la rdo rje'i nang du rlung bcug la/ res rlung mar 'phul zhing skyi dkar gyi nang khengs pa dang yar 'then/ yar 'then dus skyi dkar la bug pa 'don/ mar 'phul dus bug pa med par bya'o// de 'byongs nas lgang phu'i nang du chu blugs pi pi bskyon nas rdo rjer bcug la dbu mas drangs shing lgang phu lag pas btsir/ 'di 'byongs pa'i rtags lgang phu lag pas btsir mi dgos par 'jug pa yong ngo*// de nas sder mar chu blugs la dngos gzhi rdo rje chu 'thung ni/ lcags sam smyug ma'i sbu gu mdzub gang dang sor gsum yod pa/ phra sbom rdo rje'i sbubs las cung zad phra ba de lta bu zhig ste zangs la ni mi rung ngo*// de lta bu'i thur ma de ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la khar lan gsum bshad cing mchil ma byug cing*/ de ltar rang gi lag g.yon pas rdo rje bzung la g.yas pas thur ma dal bus rdo rje'i sbubs su bcug cing rang gis rlung ka ba gcig pas 'then la mdzub gang nang du thal byas la/ sne mo sder ma'i chu la btsugs nas lan mang du drang ngo*// pi pi dang thur ma bcug tshe rdo rje'i sbubs nas khrag 'dzag na 'brug rus dang 'bri mar sbyar la byug go// yang rtsa sgo phye drags na khams dang dri chu mi thub par 'dzag na 'brug rus dang dom mkhris gur gum dang gzhan yang mkhris sna tshogs tshad 'bri mar gyi khu bas phul la kha nas btang ngo*// yang rdo rje tsha zhing sbrid pa dang skrangs pa sogs byung na sdig srin dang se 'bru sbyar ba'i khu bas rdo rje'i phyi nang kun tu byug

/gzhan yang 'di'i gegs sel dang sman sogs logs na yod pa ltar bya'o// de ltar 'byongs nas rdo rje'i btung ba'i rdzas ni/ rab padma rakta/ 'bring rus thang la mar btab pa/ tha ma 'o ma dang khrag dkrugs la btang ngo*// 'thung ba'i dus kyi rlung gnad dang dbu ma ka 'dzugs sogs ni rgyab rlung dang khyad par med do// yang mdun rlung rgyab la sbyang ba ni/ mdun rlung brdzangs nas 'og sgo phye la/ rdo rje gnyis rlung byas pas mdun rlung rgyab tu 'gro'o// yang rgyab rlung mdun du 'byongs na rgyab rlung brdzangs la lag ngar gnyis mdun du chud bcug la/ rlung yar ma log par byas la mdun du 'phul zhing rdo rje'i mgo dgye dgye byas shing sbugs phye nas phul ba rgyab rlung mdun du 'dzugs so// nor bu chu 'thung gi zab pa'i rlung gnad ni/ stod kyi srog rlung drag tu mnan/ nor bu la pi pi sna thug tsam brdzangs nas steng rlung 'phul/ rgyab rlung bsdam dbu ma ka 'dzugs bya'o// de ltar sbyangs pa 'byongs nas pi pi dang thur ma'i rtsol ba mi dgos par rdo rjes dung 'bud pa dang skad 'byin pa sogs 'byung ngo*// 'di tsho la rtsol ba cher byas na mi 'byung mi srid do// de ni sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa gnad la dbab pa gnyis te/ dkar 'dren dang dmar 'dren gnyis so| |dang po dkar 'dren la'ang dmigs pa 'khrul 'khor gnyis las/ dmigs pa ni/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne spyi bo dang mig gnyis la zug pa spyi bor rdo rje 'chang yab yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa/ dbu ma'i mar sne gsang gnas la zug pa'i gsang gnas su thig le dkar po rnam pa he ru ka'i gzugs su gnas pa de nyid rang gi rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor byas pas/ spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma las byang sems dmar po ba thag lta bu dbu ma'i lam nas brgyud de 'ongs pas he ru ka la reg pa tsam gyis he ru ka 'od du zhu thig le dkar por gyur nas/

rdo khab len gyis lcags blangs pa ltar rtsen gyis blangs pas spyi bo'i rnal 'byor ma la sib sib thim par bsgoms te/ lus gnad sems skyil la/ rlung bzung dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyi ngang nas lag gnyis khu tshur dang po mdun du sa la brgyangs nas/ bar du mdun gyi thad kar brgyang*/ tha ma gyen du brgyang*/ ltag pa phyir bskyed/ mig gyen tu bsgril| kha gdangs la 'then mjug tu hika ces ka ba gcig pas drang ngo*// de nas lus gnad sems skyil la khu tshur mdun du brgyangs la 'then no// yang lag gnyis sor mo rkang pa'i bol du bsnol la drangs/ yang khu tshur pus steng bkab la drangs/ yang lus sgur rkang pa'i bol mtshams nas bzung la drangs/ rlung gnad gong ltar bya'o// 'drongs pa'i rtags ni/ spyi bor byang sems kyi 'brum buu cog sgar btab pa 'dra ba dang*/ 'brum bu'i nang du khams 'dzag pa dang*/ bad thor 'dra ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig la thor ba dmar po 'byung ba dang*/ mig gi steng du byang sems dkar dmar mig sprin dang*/ sha lu 'dra ba dang*/ sna bug nas 'dzag pa rnams rtags dngos su thon pa'o// 'bring yang spyi bo skrangs pa dang*/ za ba dang*/ tsha ba dang*| skyi bol ba dang*/ g.ya' ba dang*/ 'khyug pa dang*/ gzer ba dang*/ na ba dang*/ chag pa 'dra ba'i na zug 'ong ngo*// tha mas byang sems gyen du 'drongs pas bde ba skye ba dang phyir rdo rje'i sbubs las mi 'da' ba 'byung*/ de dag ni dkar 'dren rtags thon no// gnyis pa dmar 'dren rtags 'don ni/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma rkyang ma ro ma gsum yar sne tshangs bug dang mig gnyis la zug pa/ mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ dbu ma'i yar sne'i spyi bor dkar cha'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang dang*/ gsang gnas su dmar cha'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab la rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor byas pas/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsang gnas nas byang sems dkar cha'i rgyun gyi ba thag byung*/

dbu ma'i nang brgyud rnal 'byor ma la reg pa tsam gyis rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu nas byang sems dmar por gyur pa ba thag gi brgyud de yar drangs pa rtsa gsum so so'i nang du drangs la/ mig g.yas la rtags 'don na g.yas rkyang ma dkar po'i nang du drangs shing mig g.yas su sib sib thim par bsam/ mig g.yon la rtags 'don na yang dmigs pa de bsgyur/ mig gnyis ka la rtags 'don na rtsa gsum ga'i nang brgyud mig gnyis spyi bo la sib sib thim par bsam mo// lus gnad ni/ mig g.yas la rtags 'don na sems skyil/ lag g.yas khu tshur mdun du brgyang*/ g.yon pas g.yas pa'i dpung pa nas 'khrig ma'i bar du yang yang bshad cing lag g.yas dang gzugs g.yas la chun bcug /mig g.yas nam mkhar hrig cing rlung nang 'dzin pho rlung sgang dril bya'o// mig g.yon la rtags 'don na dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor de g.yon du bsgyur/ mig gnyis ka dang spyi bo dang gsum ga la rtags 'don na dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor cha mnyam khu tshur gnyis pus mgor brgyangs la 'dren no// mig gnyis spyi bo dang gsum gar rtags 'don na khu tshur gnyis snying khar bsnol nas drangs kyang chog go// rlung gnad ni steng rlung rngub 'og rlung drag tu 'then la 'dren zhing gang la rtags 'don sa de la gtad cing dril nas mdung tshugs su 'then no// yang rlung dmigs gong ltar la/ lus gnad cog pu'am lus sgur nas 'dren pa gang rung byas kyang chog go// rtags ni mig gang la rtags bton pa der sha lu lud pa 'dra ba dang*/ khrag gi 'brum pa dang*/ spyi bo yin na thor ba dmar po 'byung ba dang*/ sna nas khrag 'dzag pa sogs rtags dngos su ston nus pa 'byung ngo*// nyi ma brtod la mnan pa dang*/ zla ba btson du 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la zab khyad logs su med/ dbu ma'i sne'i dkar cha 'dren pa la zla ba btson 'dzin zer/ dmar cha 'dren pa la nyi ma brtod gnon zhes bya ba yin no// de ltar dkar 'dren dang dmar 'dren gnyis kyis legs par drangs nas lus kyi gnas rnams su ma khrems na lus yo ba dang skrangs pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa dpag tu med pa yod pas khrems kyi 'khrul 'khor zab lam drag rlung nyer lnga'i gdams pa 'di la sbyor ba/

dngos gzhi/ mdzub tshugs gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni| bla gab med pa'i gnas dag tu// sems bskyed lha la gsol ba btab// rlung ro phyir bsal rtsa byug bya// yan lag lnga ni sbyang bya ste// zhes pa las/ bla gab ces pa ni/ khang pa'i gur gyi nang du'am bla gab med na srung 'khor sgom mo// sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs byed/ lhar gsal zhes pa ni/ rang nyid kyi lha gang rung du bsgom pa'o rdo rje 'chang du bsgom na 'thad/ gsol ba 'debs pa bla ma spyi bor bsgoms la gsol ba 'debs so// rlung ro phyir bus la zhes pa ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur brla khug tu bzhag la rlung ro lan gsum 'bud pa'am yang na 'bud pa dgu phrugs byas kyang 'gal ba med do// rtsa byug zhes pa ni/ lus 'dul bya ba ste lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung la lag gnyis khu tshur gzhog drud mchan rdeb nu khar rdeg pa gsum dang lag g.yon bsgrengs pa g.yas kyis lan gsum bshud/ g.yas la'ang de bzhin bya/ de nas lag gnyis kha sbub thur du bsnol bas brang lan gsum bshud/ byang bshud la dmar ram lto ba rgyab mdun zur rnams 'bros 'ded du 'phur la/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang lag gnyis khu tshur gzhibs pa g.yon phyogs su thur du bsgreng*/ mig dang gdong rkang pa g.yas la gtad/ slar yang rkang pa lan gsum bshud/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin byas la lus gnad steng nas rlung btang*/ drag rlung nyer lnga'i ring lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis khu tshur brla khug tu bzhag /dpung pa rong byas te 'di rtsa 'dab gzhung gi 'khrul 'khor lus gnad en tsam mi gcig pa 'di shrī ba'i lugs so| |yan lag lnga ni sbyang bya ste// zhes pa'i yan lag lnga sbyong ste/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung*/ mgo bo g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum mgo bo mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon du bcag pa gsum gsum bya/ de nas pus btsugs rkang pa rgyab tu bsnol lag g.yon ma la mar bkan/

lag g.yas kyis zhags skyur gsum g.yon pas gsum mnyam du gsum byas la khu tshur 'phongs kyi 'og tu bcug la/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang bskum gsum dang g.yon pas gsum byas la rlung btang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rdo rje gyen log rdo rje mda' 'phen dang*// zhes pa'i rdo rje gyen log ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung la mtheb mos mtheb mor 'khyud pa kha sbub mdun du brgyang*/ slar nu khar sleb tshe yar bsgyur la gan rkyal byas la mthe bong glod la mdun du brgyang ba gsum bya'o// rdo rje mda' 'phen ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis thal mo brdab cing mda' 'phen pa'i tshul dang gru 'bebs bya'o// pus mo lcags thag rting pa sgyid pa bsrang*| |pus mo lcags thag ni/ rkang pa pus btsugs kha sbub rkang pa phyir bkan rkang pa'i brang sar phab la lag pa gnyis 'doms su brkyangs nas lag pa g.yas pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang lag g.yon rkang g.yas 'then pa'o// rting pa sgyid pa bsrang ba ni/ yar langs la rkang pa g.yas pa'i rting pa tshang ra g.yas la sbyar ba lag g.yas pas 'then zhing lag g.yon khu tshur dpyi zur du thur du brgyang ba g.yon la'ang de ltar bya'o// skyil krung ltag 'then skyil krung lag bcang dang*// skyil krung ltag 'then ni/ rdo rje skyil krung byas la lag pa gnyis kyis rgyab nas bsnol te brkyangs la rkang pa gnyis kyi mthe bong nas 'then no// skyil krung lag bcang ni/ rdo rje skyil krung byas pa'i sgyid khug gnyis nas lag pa gnyis brkyangs te rna ba gnyis la 'jus nas 'then no// rus sbal bzo dang padma'i 'dug stangs dang*// rus sbal bzo ni/ rkang mthil gnyis sbyar la mdun du brkyang lag gnyis brla 'og nas brkyangs la tshang ra'i steng du sor bcu bsnol nas 'then no// padma'i 'dug stangs ni/ rkang mthil gnyis sbyar la mdun du brkyang lag gnyis sgyid pa'i 'og nas brkyangs la sor bcu 'thain/

sgyid pa'i 'og tu brkyangs la rkang mgo sor bcu bsnol bas gcud la lag pas mar 'then rkang pas mar 'phul lo// rdo rje sgang dril srin po raksha mnye// rdo rje sgang dril ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung rgyab phyogs su pi tsi ling du dril la de ma thag tu pus mo btsugs// lag gnyis sked par brten la g.yas gcu g.yon gcu bya'o// srin po raksha mnye ba ni/ mgo rgyab tu phab lag pa gnyis kyis sked pa brten/ mjing pa dang gru mo gnyis sar btsugs/ rkang pa gnyis gnam du shed kyis brkyangs nas slar g.yas bskums pa'i rkang mthil g.yon pa'i brla rtsar sbyar te g.yon bsgreng*/ g.yon la'ang de bzhin bya'o// de 'dra res mos gsum byas la rkang pa gnam du rdo rje skyil krung byas la g.yas gcu g.yon gcu rgyab tu gcu ba gsum gsum bya'o// rdo rje snyoms 'jug g.yas bskum ltag 'then dang*/ /rdo rje snyoms 'jug ni/ langs te sgur ba'i rkang pa g.yon 'og dang g.yas steng du 'ong bar byas pa'i rjes/ lag ngar bsnol rkang mgo gshibs pa'i lag pa g.yon 'og g.yas steng du byas la rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis nas 'then zhing mgo dang dpung pa g.yas su gcu phyag rgya de bsgyur ba g.yon la'ang bya'o// g.yas bskum ltag 'then ni/ langs pa'i rkang g.yas g.yon pa'i brla khug tu rdog bzhag lag gnyis khu tshur dpyi'i thad du rkang pa g.yon la'ang de 'dra bya'o/ rdo rje sbrul 'khyud yi dwags 'dug stangs dang*// rdo rje sbrul 'khyud ni/ langs pa'i rkang g.yas g.yon la 'khril zhing lag pa gnam du bsgrengs pa'i g.yas g.yon la 'khril/ g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga bsgongs nas dpral bar sbrul mgo ltar byas la lus kun g.yas su gcu g.yon la'ang de 'dra bya'o// yi dwags 'dug stangs ni/ tsog pu byas pa'i rkang pa'i rting pa bteg brang nga sar phab lag gnyis rgyab tu thal mo sbyar ro/ */lha yi 'dug stangs nya mo 'khyug stangs dang*/ */

lha yi 'dug stangs ni/ langs te rkang pa gshibs nas lag pa rgyab tu sked pa'i thad du phyag rgya bcas la gru mo thur du mnan no// nya mo 'khyug stangs ni/ lus brkyang kha sbub rkang pa'i brang nga sa la btsugs/ lag gnyis cung zad sngon du brkyangs pa'i lag mthil sar phab/ sked pa nyag /mgo dang brang dgye zhing rlung phyir 'dzin/ kha nas og og ces thad du 'phar zhing g.yas g.yon du 'phrad nyad nyad mchong ngo*// rdo rje bde skyong lam mchog chig rdzogs dang*// rdo rje bde skyong ni/ kha sbub rkang pa rgyab tu bsnol/ lag ngar sar phab g.yas thog g.yon 'og tu bsnol la khu tshur gyen du sgreng zhing g.yas su gcus la chun bcug /g.yon du'ang phyag rgya de bsgyur la bya'o// lam mchog chig rdzogs ni/ langs te rkang pa gshibs pa'i khu tshur gnyis gzhog drud mchan rdeb mdun du brgyangs la g.yas dang g.yon dang dbus rnams su khu tshur mkhrig ma gnyis sprad la lan gsum gsum gcu zhing sdod pa'i tshe/ khu tshur smin mtshams su bsnol ba thur du lhod kyis glod la 'bebs rgyag go// bshang lam gyen log pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor dang*// bshang lam gyen log ni sngar gyi srin po raksha dang 'dra'o// pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor ni/ lus gnad steng nas rlung bzung nas pho ba g.yas skor g.yon skor gsum bya'o// seng ge rnam rol sna tshogs dgram pa dang*// seng ge rnam rol ni/ rlung phyir bus nang du mi brngub par lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis kyis rna ba gnyis bkag /mthe'u chung dang srin lag bzhis kha btsums/ gung mo gnyis kyis sna bug bkag /mdzub mo gnyis kyis mig bkab la mgo bo g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum bya'o// sna tshogs dgram pa ni/ rlung bzung lus sgur pus mo gnyis dang khu tshur gnyis sar phab la g.yas bcu g.yon gcu res mos su gsum re dang lus sprug go| |ha 'bebs rnam snang ldan pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom// ha 'bebs ni/

lus gnad tsog pu lag mthil gnyis pus mgor bkab la kha nas hag ces brjod cing 'phongs rdeb pa'i 'bebs chung bya'o| |rnam snang ldan pa'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag sogs lus rnam snang gi chos bdun byas la ting 'dzin yud tsam zhig bsgom mo// gsum pa rjes ni bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o// de dag ni zab lam drag rlung nyer lnga'i 'khrul 'khor rim pa dag go// de ltar mdun thur gyi sbyor ba la brten nas byang sems kunda mi nyams par bya ba dang*/ nyi ma brtod gnon dang*/ zla ba btson 'dzin gyi man ngag rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa'i sbyor bas 'dren 'grems kyi tshul du nyams su blangs pas/ gnas skabs su thig le nad gdon gang gis kyang mi 'dzag par srung zhing mthar thug tshul khrims rin po che bsrung ba la mdun thur 'di med du mi rung ba'i yan lag yin te/ ci'i phyir na/ skyes bu'i rtsol ba la brten nas 'dzag pa lta ci smos/ gdon dang*/ nad dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ gcin la sogs kyis nyams pa de'ang tshul khrims 'chal ba'i yan lag tu 'gro bas de thams cad nyes pa khegs pa la sogs pa'i dgos ched dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir ro// de dag ni rlung gi rtsa 'dab kyi rim pa bstan pa dag go// gsum pa thig le'i rtsa 'dab ni/ gnyis te/ rang lus thabs ldan dang*/ gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis so// dang po la'ang sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba la'ang dmigs pa dang*/ rlung rtsol/ 'khrul 'khor gsum ste/ dbang mdor bstan las/ dbang po bkrag 'byin mig dmar zangs kyi gzer bus btab// ces gsungs pas/ sngon 'gro dang po ngag 'dren zhi drag gi dmigs pa ni/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne spyi bo dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ haṃ yig dkar po gsang gnas su thig le dkar po ba'i 'o ma lta bu yod pa ste/

sbyor ba ngag 'dren zhi drag gis 'dren pa'i tshe gsang gnas kyi dkar cha'i thig le dang rang gi nor bu'i sbubs nas rlung kha dog lnga ldan zhig dang phyogs gcig tu drangs nas spyi bo'i haṃ la thim par bsam/ 'khrul 'khor ni dang po sbyor ba ngag 'dren zhi ba ni/ kha sbub rkang lag gi ngar gdong sar phab khu tshur bcangs nywa bzhi'i sha bsgrims lus la chun bcug dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyi hūm̐ ring thung gis drag tu 'then no// gnyis pa sbyor ba ngag 'dren drag po ni/ lus gnad rkang pa 'phred du bzhag pa'i rting pa sprad pa cung zad bteg pas 'phongs bkyags/ rkang pa'i brang nga sar phab pa padma'i skyil krung langs pa'i stabs kyis lag gnyis khu tshur bsdams pa snying khar bsnol te hūm̐ ring thung gis drag tu 'then no// sngon 'gro gnyis pa dud 'gro 'gyur bzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne spyi bor zug pa'i sner bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum du gsal btab/ dbu ma'i mar sne rdo rje la zug pa'i sne mor dmar cha'i dwangs ma las grub pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu thur dang bha ga steng du bstan pa zhig gsal gdab kyis rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor byas pa'i tshe spyi bor bla ma yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar po ba thag gi rgyun skya nar gyis byung*/ rnal 'byor ma'ibha ga la reg pa tsam gyis rnal 'byor ma byang sems dmar por ltem gyis zhu/ ba thag gis 'then pa'i tshe glang chen hing gis lte ba/ stag mo ngur gyis snying kha/ gcan gzan skyug gis mgrin pa/ wa ltar snom gyis spyi bor drangs te rdo rje 'chang yab yum la thim pas bla ma yab yum dang bdag brjod med kyi bde bas myos shing tshim par bsam/ dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhi'i lus gnad kha sbub/ rkang lag ngar gdong sar/ ltag pa phyir bkan/ mig gyen du bsgril/ sked pa nyag byas la/

dang po glang chen hing la hi hing zhes dang*/ gnyis pa stag mo ngur la ngur ngur zhes dang*/ gsum pa gcan zan skyug la ha hag ces dang*/ bzhi pa wa ltar bsnom la hū hūm̐ zhes pa dbu ma ka 'dzugs drag po'i 'bad pa bskyed la 'then no// de rnams ni snga ma snga mas drangs shing*/ phyi ma phyi mas phul ba yin no// dmigs pa gsal ba gnad che'o// sngon 'gro gsum pa rjes gcod bzhi'i dang po zhags pa ltar 'phang ba ni/ lus gnad sems skyil rlung bzung la/ lag pa g.yas pas zhags skyur gsum g.yon pas gsum rnams bya'o// gnyis pa ske rags ltar bcing ba ni/ sems skyil lag gnyis sor mo brkyangs pa sked la 'ching ba ltar gsum 'bros 'ded du gsum gsum bya'o// gsum pa 'khor lo ltar bskor ba ni/ sems skyil la sked pa g.yas skor gsum g.yon skor gsum bya'o// bzhi pa bu chung gi spyod pa ni/ tsog pu lag gnyis pus 'khyud byas la mdun du 'gyel zhing 'bebs chung bya/ de bzhin du g.yas dang rgyab dang g.yon rnams su 'gyel zhing 'bebs chung re bya/ 'gyel dus tsog pu pus 'khyud ma zhig par bya/ de dag ni rang lus thabs ldan dang gzhan lus thabs ldan gnyis ka'i sngon 'gro ste 'di rnams shin tu byang chub pa dgos so| |gnyis pa dngos gzhi rang lus thabs ldan lde mig gdams ngag bstan pa ni/ lus gnad sems skyil khu tshur pus steng brgyangs la/ gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang rtsa dbu ma dang bcas pa gsal btab la spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms la mchod cing*/ thabs ldan rtsa rlung gi gdams pa bsgom pa la bar chad med cing 'dod chags lam du lhong bar gsol ba btab ste bla ma rang la bstims la/ dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab bo// de nas lam gyi dngos gzhi ni/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma yar sne spyi bo dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ dbu ma'i mar sne rang gi rdo rje'i sne mor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bha ga gyen du bstan pa'i bha gas rang gi rdo rje la reg tsam du yod pa/

dbu ma'i yar sne haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan du yod par bsam/ de nas rang nyid sems skyil la/ lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du brgyangs la lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bha gar bsams te/ rtse mo dang rtsa ba kho na ma yin par sked pa nas mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis kyis bzung zhing mdzub mo gzhan rnams kyis reg tsam dal bus rdo rje bsgreng zhing shin tu mkhrang bar gyur nas cung zad bskyod la rang gi lus kyi thig le bab ste bde ba g.yo ba lag pas bsdams la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa spangs te mnyam par bzhag /yang cung zad bskyod la mi bzod pa'i bde ba 'byung bas de'i ngo bo la mnyam par bzhag /yang bskyod la bde ba cher g.yos nas sa bon rdo rje'i sbubs su 'byung bas phyir thon na gegs su 'gyur bas sgo rtsar 'don la khad byung ba'i tshe/ mthe bong dang gung mo gnyis kyis rdo rje dam du bsdam zhing mdzub mos rdo rje'i sbubs kyi bug pa bkag ste/ sngar bshad pa'i rlung rtsol dang*/ lus gnad dang*/ sems skyil steng nas dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhi sogs kyis 'dren zhing 'grems la 'bad/ 'di'i dus su dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhi sogs la lus gnad sgur mi dgos sems skyil kho na'i steng nas bya'o// de'i tshe myur du bskyod nas bde ba cher skyes nas lus gnad rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams kyis ldog tu ma btub par thig le 'chor du nye ba na/ lag pa g.yas kyis rdo rje dam du bzung*/ lus gnad tsog pu la khu tshur g.yon brang la sbyar/ nywa bzhi'i sha sgrim gling bzhi bsdu mig gyen du hrig /'og rlung steng du drangs shing steng rlung mnan/ rgyab rlung bsdam/ dbus rlung dkrugs te rlung bum can pho rlung stod du bsgril la/ lus thams cad stod du bzung zhing gyen du drangs pas 'gro ba la the tshom med do// de ltar yang yang 'bad pas sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i tshe rdo rje'i sbubs mdzub mos dgag pa rdo rje lag pas btsir ba sogs mi dgos par rang dbang thob nas rtsa rlung gi gnyen lcugs la brtan pa thob ste thig le dbang du 'dus nas/

brjod med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod de 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mngon sum du tshegs med par tshe 'di nyid la mchog gi dngos grub thob par gdon mi za ba ni rang lus thabs ldan zhes sam/ rang lus lde mig gi lam 'di nyams su blangs pa'i mthar thug gi yon tan yin la/ gnas skabs su/ rgas sra gnyer ma mi 'byung*/ mdog legs gzhon sha chags/ skra dkar yang nag por 'gyur/ grub pa brgyad thob pa sogs dgos ched dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i phyir ro// de dag ni rang lus zhal gdams kyi skor ro/ */'di la gzhung tshigs bcad ma zhig dang de'i yig chung zhig 'dug kyang 'dir bshad ma thag pa 'di las logs su gyur pa'i zab khyad mi 'dug pas 'dir ma bris shing de nyid kyi don la lta bar 'dod na gud du yod pas der rtogs shig /gnyis pa gzhan lus thabs ldan nam lde mig bstan pa la gzhung dang*/ man ngag gnyis las/ dang po gzhung ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i zab khyad mkha' 'gro'i snying*// 'jigs med grags pa'i man ngag shing rta'i srol// nam lhun sprul sku'i zhal gyi gdams pa'i bcud// 'jam dbyangs ras pa'i myong khrid sbags khrid 'di// brjed 'jigs skal ldan grol phyir bri bar bya// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros gnang du gsol// 'di la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi// dang po sbyor ba ngag 'dren zhi drag dang*// 'gyur bzhi rnam grol rjes bcad rnam pa bzhi// pho khrid khong 'dzin gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya la sogs man ngag zhal las shes// gnyis pa dngos gzhi mi med dben gnas su// skyabs 'gro byin rlabs sems bskyed lhar gsal sogs// mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// dgra bo ngo lci dogs zon sngon la bya// thos bsam bsgoms pas phyi nang bar la 'bad// rigs lnga dbu ma zung 'jug sman mchog btang*// gnad zin rgan po bu chen phyi nang bskrad// brkyang bskum me long brtson 'grus gcig chog blta// zung 'jug g.yo med bya ra rigs gsum 'bad// gnad zin gling bzhi sa mgo gnam sa slog

/oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang phaṭa dang rgya mtsho bsnun// 'gyur bzhi rtsa sprug yang dang yang du 'bad// bde stong rtog med ngom pa med pa sogs// de 'drar 'drongs pa'i rtags rnams zhal las shes// rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud snying po sbags khrid 'di// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la sbyin par bya// skal med snying rus med la byin pa na// ma dang mkha' 'gros snying khrag 'thung bar nges// de bas rang gi snying ltar 'chang bar gces// de las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i mthus// 'dod chags sor rtog ngang du gsal gyur cig /zung 'jug bde chen chos sku thob par shog /ces bya ba ni 'jam dbyangs ras chen gyis gsungs pa ste gzhung gi rim pa'o// gnyis pa de'i gsal byed man ngag gdams pa ni| sngon 'gro ngag 'dren zhi drag 'gyur bzhi rjes bcad rnams dang rlung them rdo rje khong rgyong yang sngon du btang nas rig ma'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams la goms pa'i bde ba la goms 'dris sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhi la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas/ yab yum gnyis ka lhar gsal btab/ phan tshun mkha' gsang byin rlabs res bya/ shes rab kyis mi shes na rang gis bslab pa'o// dgra bo ngo lci sogs ni/ gal te shes rab skye mched mtshar ba rigs bzang ba dang 'phrad na ri bong can dbang med du 'chor bas de 'dra'i rigs la thog mar rang lus ltar rtsa them rgyab/ ri bong can dbab ldog byas pas rdo rje'i ngar chag nas shin tu dul bar 'byung ngo*// yang na rdo rje las rung langs pa de la 'dren drag po bstud pas ngar chag nas rjes su rang 'dod 'byung ngo*// de ltar sngon du ma byas na ri bong can 'chor bar 'gyur ro// thos bsam bsgoms pas phyi nang bar la 'bad// ces pa ni/ dang por bha ga'i rigs la brtags te phyi rgyas la kha rub pa nang rtsub pa'i rigs 'dug na rtsa rigs bzang bas ri bong can bzung dka' bas de'i lugs kyis dang po nas shin tu dal bu tshod lta yin bya'o// gal te phyi bskams la kha gdang nang 'jam pa 'dug na ri bong can shor dogs chung bas rang gi mdzub mos padma'i nang legs par brtags la phyi nang sgro 'dogs legs par bcad nas 'bub med bya ba'i don no// rigs lnga ni sor mo lnga'o| |dbu ma ni rdo rje'o// rang gi sor mo'am rig mas rdo rje las rung byed pa'o// zung 'jug sman mchog ni/

gal te bha ga gsar pa shin tu dam pa rdo rjes mi phig par 'dug na mar dang snum mchil ma'i lde mig gis sgo phye nas 'gro zhes pa'o// gnad zin rgan po bu chen phyi nang bskrad// ces pa ni/ bha ga'i nang na 'gro lugs yang na rgan po 'am rus sbal ltar dal bus 'gro/ yang na bu chen po'am mda' 'phang ba ltar mdzod phugs su thal gyis 'gro yi/ 'gro la mi 'gro'i rnam pa mang na ri bong can 'chor bas de ltar mi byed par phugs su thag gis phyin/ sgo dam du bcad la tsab tsub kyi spros pa mi bya bar g.yo med du bsdad do// brkyang bskum me long btson 'grus gcig chog blta// zhes pa ni/ rang gi rkang pa gnyis brkyang shes rab ma yi rkang pa gnyis bskum pa'o// me long ni lte ba phyir 'phul srin po 'chum mo/ brtson 'grus rtsab rtsub mi bya bar gcig chog bde ba chen po'i rang zhal lta'o// zung 'jug g.yo med bya ra rigs gsum 'bad| |ces pa ni/ bde ba'i rtsal che chung dang bstun/ rdo rje gsor ba'i rtsol ba chung 'bring chen po'i bya ra rigs gsum la 'bad ces pa'o// gnad zin zhes pa bde ba'i rang rtsal rdzogs pa'o| |gling bzhi sa mgo gnam sa slog /ces pa ni/ 'dren 'dzin byed pa ste rang gi yan lag bzhi bskums shing chun bcug /rgya mtsho ri la sbyar/ dbang po'i mchog gnyis mkha' la gtad/ sgo gnyis ri bo'i rtse la slog pa'o// oṃ dang hūm̐ dang phaṭa dang rgya mtsho bsnun/ zhes pa ni/ oṃ ni spyi bo'i haṃ la sems gtad nas 'dren no// hūm̐ ni hūm̐ gi ngag 'dren dngos gzhi 'gyur la sogs pa'o// phaṭa ni bde ba che drags sa bon cis kyang mi thub pa'i grabs 'dug na phaṭa ces rdo rje phyir bton nas gong ltar 'dren 'grems bya'o// de rnams kyi gzhung la 'bru bsnan pa'o// lus gnad dang po brkyang phyis cung zad bskum lus kyi them bu gong ltar la rlung them ni mdun rlung drag tu phul/

rgyab rlung cung zhig 'then nas 'byung 'jug 'khor mar 'dzin 'dren 'grems gsum dus gcig la 'byung ba thun mong ma yin pa'i them bu sngar nor bu sbubs 'dren gyi zhal shes bka' rgya ma ltar yin gsung ngo*// gsum pa bsngo ba smon lam byas la phyag rgya chen pos rgyas btab pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /'di'i lag len dang dmigs pa rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor sogs ni bcu gnyis zin bris su gsal bas der rtogs par byos shig /de ltar gzhan lus thabs ldan zhes sam/ gzhan lus lde mig ces bya ba'i lam zab mo 'di nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon ni gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis so// dang po gnas skabs su tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ rgas sra ba dang*/ gnyer ma mi 'byung ba dang*/ skra mi dkar ba dang*/ gzhon sha chags pa dang*/ rgas nas kyang lus mi sgur ba dang*/ tshe'i rig 'dzin 'grub pa dang*/ ral gri la sogs grub pa brgyad 'thob pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pa dang*/ mtshon dang rdo'i gnod pa dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa dang*/ dug dang yams la sogs pa nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ gdon rigs stong phrag bco brgyad/ than dang ltas ngan la sogs pa gang gis kyang mi gnod cing 'tshe bar mi nus par 'byung ba la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med do// gnyis pa mthar thug la'ang lam 'bras bu gnyis las/ dang po lam gyi dus ni/ mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa nyan thos dang mdo sde pa'i lam kun spyod kho na gtso bor byas pa bskal pa mang por grol du re ba dang*/ phyag chen pa kho na'i lam dang po nyid nas the tshom gyi phreng ba la bcos lhad dang dgag sgrub kho nas mi tshe mang por 'gyu ba'i mtha' ma chod pas ngal ba la mthar thug chos sku rtogs su re ba dang*/ rdzogs chen pa lta bu'i lta ba'i rbad kham shin tu che zhing sgom pa lha rig 'dre rig kho na dang 'ja' 'od la zhen pa spyod pa 'di yin med par sems kyi ngo bo tsam ma gtogs kyang gnyis 'dzin gyi reg pa dug lnga'i dbang du btang la chos sku rtogs su re ba dang*/

dbu ma chen po'i lam ltar rang stong dang gzhan stong kho nas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du thag chod kyang stong tshul la kha mi 'cham par the tshom gyi 'phrang kho na'i ngang las dpe klog dang tshig gi phreng ba la ltos nas chos sku rtogs su re ba dang*/ gcod yul pa'i lam ltar snang srid thams cad sems su thag chod ma chod ci yin yang sems su thag bcad/ sems gsal stong gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i lugs gcig dang*/ yang bdud la sogs pa rang sems las logs su ma grub pas med kyang phyi rol du yod pa ltar rlom ste mgron du 'bod pa ltar byed cing*/ don gnas 'gyu tsam yang ma rtogs par log pa'i spyod lam kho nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs par kha 'phangs nas lta sgom spyod pa gang yang med par phaṭa sgra 'brug ltar sgrog cing mchor chas la zhen nas chos sku rtogs su re ba ste/ de lta bu'i lam the tshom can gnyis 'dzin gyi dra ba'i srad bus bcings shing mthar thug gi lhan skyes kyi lta ba la ma rig pa'i ling tog gis mig rab tu longs pa rnams kyi spyod yul du gyur pa'i lam de lta bu dag dang*/ lam de rnams kyis 'bras bu ji lta ba re thob na thob bya'i 'bras bu gcig kyang*/ lam de rnams la brten nas ma 'ongs pa'i dus ring po zhig tu 'bras bu thon srid kyang*/ de'i bar du gol sa dang bar chad mang zhing legs nyes phran bu tsam gyi rgyu 'bras la brten nas skabs mtshams zhig nas ngan song du song ba mang ba las/ chos kyi sku thob pa re re tsam srid pas lam de rnams shin tu bul ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thugs kyis mnag pa zab pa bas kyang ches zab pa'i lam thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhi thog nas lam bsgom ma dgos par 'bras bu da lta nyid du thob pa'i thabs rig ma'i lus rgya la brten nas skad cig ma de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye 'gag gnas gsum 'byung 'jug gang yang med pa brjod pa'i yul dang po las 'das pa/

gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang shar 'di mthong la/ mthong tsam nyid nas ngo 'phrod la/ 'phrod ma thag tu grol ba/ tshe 'dir chen po gsum gyis ma reg pa'i rtogs pa mtshan ma'i mtha' dang bral zhing brjod du med pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes chos sku'i rang bzhin rje 'jig rten mgon po'i bzhed pa ji lta ba de'ang*/ des rtogs par 'gyur gyi lam gzhan gyis rtogs par nam yang mi 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ bud med gzugs dang mdangs bzang ma// lo grangs bcu drug lon pa la// byin gyis brlabs te gnas gsum du// dben par mchod pa rab tu brtsam// zhes dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba las| |blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces dang*/ yang*/ thabs 'di spangs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// nam yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes sogs dpag tu med pa gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ lam thams cad kyi snying por gyur pa zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po da lta nyid du thob par byed thabs dam pa ste/ de thob tshul ni rig ma'i lus rgya la brten pa'i skad cig ma de la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod de chos kyi skur rtogs pa de'i ngang bar dor skad cig ma dang po la chos sku'i ye shes sam babs kyi rang rtsal longs sku nges pa lnga ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon sum du 'grub par gdon mi za ba'i phyir ro// de dag gis thig le rtsa 'dab kyi rim pa yongs su rdzogs par grub bo// de rnams ni gsung rdo rje'i khrid ces bya'o// gsum pa thugs rdo rje'i khrid la/ dbu mar sems 'jug pa/ 'ja' lus sgrub pa/ sna rtse gsum gyi man ngag dang gsum las/ dang po dbu mar sems 'jug ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang la/ mi rtag 'chi ba bsam pa bcas song nas/ sgra gcan thig le rlung gi gnad// g.yon nas bteg bcu 'og tu rdeg

/rlung rnams ma lus grol bar 'gyur// bde chen khyad par thig le'i gnad// yar la drangs shing a yig gsal byas te// myur du rlung rnams ma lus grol bar gyur// rdo rje gyad 'then srog rtsol lte bar sdud// khu tshur brlar bzhag sems nyid nam mkhar 'phang*// lta ba'i rgyas 'debs sems nyid chos skur 'phrod// myur du rlung rnams ma lus grol bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang 'og thur sel la brten nas rlung sems dbu mar 'jug tshul ni/ drag po'i sbyor bas rlung sems dbu mar bcug /mtha' bral chos sku'i ngang du ngo 'phrod pas// myur du rgyal ba'i go 'phang rtogs par 'gyur// dgang 'then gyad bzhis las rlung dbu mar thim// bde chen kha sbyor rtsa gnyis bsrang byas te// myur du grol lam dag la sbyangs byas te// 'od gsal mchog la myur du 'god par 'gyur/ 'khor lo bcud ldan zag med bdud rtsis brgyan// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi 'bros 'ded bya// myur du bde chen rlung las grol bar 'gyur// bar du bde chen kha sbyor la brten nas| |rlung sems dbu ma'i khyim du 'jug par 'gyur// srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba rab bkag nas// ye shes dbu ma'i rten la rab 'byor bar// las rlung ye shes dbu mar thim par 'gyur| |srog rtsol rlung gi rgyu ba rab bkag nas// dbu ma mchog la rab tu brten byas te// ye shes ting nge 'dzin ni 'thob par 'gyur// srog rtsol gyad snol las rlung dbu mar bcug |rnam dag lta ba'i rtsibs kyis rgyas btab nas// myur du 'gyur ba'i chos las grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di'i sgom lugs dang lus gnad rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor sogs zhib pa zhal las dris shig /de dag ni dbu mar sems 'jug gi rim pa'o// gnyis pa 'ja' lus sgrub pa la'ang gsum ste/ lus snang stong 'ja' lus su sgrub pa/ ngag grag stong 'ja' lus su sgrub pa/

sems gsal stong 'ja' lus su sgrub pa'o// dang po lus snang stong 'ja' lus su bsgrub pa ni/ rang rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i lus dbus na rtsa dbu ma ka ba gcig pa 'od lnga dang ldan pa dmigs rten byas la bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob pa dang rang lus 'ja' lus su bsgom/ de la brtan pa thob pa dang che ba mi dang chung ba shig la sogs pa mthong tshad 'ja' lus su bsgom/ mthar phyi snod thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi gzhal yas khang nang bcud 'gro ba thams cad 'ja' lus kyi skur bsgoms te 'bad pas sbyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ngag grag stong 'dzin med 'ja' lus su bsgrub pa ni/ res ngag skad chen por grag pa de ni ngo bo grag stong brjod bral 'dzin med du shes par bya zhing*/ de nas ngag gang smras pa grag stong brjod bral skye med du yun ring por sbyangs shing bslab par bya'o// gsum pa sems gsal stong skye med 'ja' lus su bsgrub pa ni/ sems 'di dang po gang nas byung*/ bar du gang du gnas/ tha mar gang du 'gro/ dang por skyes pa/ bar du dar ba/ tha mar 'chi ba sogs ci 'dug legs par brtags te/ mthar brjod med dpe bral gsal stong skye med du goms par bya zhing 'ja' lus sgrub thabs gsum po 'di/ zhib cha bla ma'i zhal khrid dang nyams khrid la ltos dgos so// de dag ni 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i thabs so// gsum pa sna rtse gsum gyi man ngag la/ spros bcas dang spros med gnyis so// spros bcas la'ang rags pa dang phra thig gnyis las/ dang po rags pa ni/ sems mi brtan pa brtan par byed pa'i thabs ni/ rang gi gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang sngon por gsal btab pa'i lus kyi dkyil na yar sne rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo ba nang dmar ba'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed tsam zhig gsal btab/ de'i steng du rakta'i dwangs ma a shad rta rnga phyed gshags tsam mgo thur du bstan pa gcig la 'od zer du ba'i rnam pa hūm̐ sngon po nas 'bru tsam phyir 'gro ba dang*/

nang du 'ong ba oṃ dkar po yungs 'bru tsam gnas pa/ āḥdamar po dpal 'bru tsam zhig a shad kyi steng du gnas pa zhi gnas yin/ lhag mthong ni oṃ āḥl bsdu/ āḥ.oṃ la bsdu/ oṃ a shad kyi steng du gnas so// de la sems gtad la bsgom pa ni rags pa'o// gnyis pa phra thig gi sna rtse gsum sgom pa'i man ngag ni gsum ste/ gdong gi sna rtse 'od kyi thig le/ snying gi sna rtse sngags kyi thig le/ gsang ba'i sna rtse rdzas kyi thig le dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po gdong gi sna rtse 'od kyi thig le ni/ rang gi sna rtser thig le phyi sngo dbus dkar po yungs 'bru tsam 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba la sems gtad do// gnyis pa snying gi sna rtse sngags kyi thig le ni/ rang gi snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma phyed tsam zhig gi steng du a shad rta rnga phyed gshags tsam zhig 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba gdong gi sna rtse'i thig le la thim par bsgom mo// gsum pa gsang ba'i sna rtse rdzas kyi thig le ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo/ snying ga'i 'khor lo/ lte ba'i 'khor lo rnams 'od zer sbu gu'i rnam pa khra shig ge ba zhig gsal btab/ lte ba'i 'khor lo nas thig le dkar dmar yungs 'bru tsam gsang rtser bab/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa la sems gtad la de las gang du ma yeng bar de kho na la sems gtad la 'bad pa drag pos bsgom mo// gnyis pa spros pa med pa sna rtse'i rdzogs rim ni/ bram ze chen po sa ra has// gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// rgyab dang mdun dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong bas de de nyid// ces dang*/ sa ra has/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med| |ces dang*/ mda' bsnun gyis// gang zhig sems las rnam 'phros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan min nam// srid dang mnyam nyid nam mkha'i rang bzhin no// zhes dang*/

sa ra has/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i don// 'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes dang*/ sha wa ris/ gnyis med lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i ro// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag ro gcig ltar// ji lta'i ngang du de bzhin gnas pa'i tshe// dmigs 'dzin zhen pa'i yid de rab tu zhi// zhes dang*/ tog tse bas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad// tshogs drug dag na bde ba rgyun mi 'chad// byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu// sgom du med do gnyug ma'i ngang du zhog /ces dang*| sha wa ris/ gaṅgā la sogs chu klung sna tshogs pa// ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor ro gcig ltar// btags pa'i sems dang sems byung sna tshogs pa// chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig shes par byos// zhes dang*/ nā ro pas/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i// sangs rgyas med cing sems can med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba sems can gyi dus ngan du med cing sangs rgyas kyi dus bzang du ma song ba/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas btsal bas rnyed pa dang mi pha rol pos ngo sprad pa sogs ma yin pa/ ye gdod ma nas rang la yod pa slar yang rang gis byan tshud pa/ dang po gang las kyang ma skyes/ bar du cis kyang mi 'gag /mthar gang du'ang mi gnas/ byung ba'i rgyu med/ gnas pa'i yul med/ 'gro ba'i sa med/ kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gnas kyang 'gyu la/ 'gyu yang rig pa/ rig tsam nyid nas rtogs ma thag gsal zhing rjen pa 'gyu ba/ bzang por shar yang bdag tu ma byas pa/ ngan pa byung yang dgos rgyu med pa/ bzang ngan ci shar yang re dogs dang bral ba/ 'gyu ba de'i rjes su ma 'brangs pa/ yang de bkag pa'ang ma yin pa/ de 'dra 'gyu yang de ma thag tu rang gi ngo bos stong pa/ stong pa'i ngo bo de gsal lhang nge ba/ gsal ba de'i 'jug ldang snang ba sna tshogs pa 'phro ba de thams cad kyang don gsal stong brjod bral kho nar mthong ba/

de lta bus nyin mo 'da' bar bya zhing mtshan yang de lta bu kho na la rtsal sbyangs pas nyin mtshan kho ra khor yug tu 'gyu ba bzang ngan thams cad gsal stong sems su thag chod nas/ de'i rang mdangs ngo bo la ma yeng tsam hrig hrig pa la bslab par bya'i/ 'di la sgom zhes 'dug sa gcig tu lus gnad dang bcas nas sdod pa'i tshe sgom rgyu yod du re zhing 'gro 'dug dang nyal ldang gi tshe gar song cha med du dgos pa de 'dra 'dir bya mi dgos te/ gang dang gang gi las dang rnam g.yeng de rnams kyang gong du bshad ma thag pa ltar rang babs su glod la dog dog tu mi bsgrim zhing rang shugs su rtsol med kyi dran pa rgyun chags su bzhag go// de'i tshe shugs 'byung du 'gyu ba phra mo dran pa'i rtsis ma zin pa kha cig 'byung yang de la bzang ngan gyi re dogs gang yang bya mi dgos/ rang babs su lhod kyis bzhag pas phyag rgya chen po kho na'i rol par 'gyur zhing*/ de la sbyangs shing goms pas 'gyu ba phra mo de'ang gsal stong gzung 'dzin dang bral bar shar nas mthar nyin mtshan thams cad du phyag rgya chen po kho na'i rol pa las gang du'ang mi 'da' bar brtan pa thob pa zhig 'byung bar 'gyur bas/ de ltar ma gyur gyi bar du 'bad rtsol drag pos ci nas kyang bsgom par bya'o| |de dag ni spros pa med pa'i sna rtse gsum gyi man ngag go// des thugs rdo rje'i khrid yongs su grub pa yin no// gsum pa mjug ston las dang 'dra ba 'bras bu bsdu ba'i khrid ni/ rtsa'i rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud thabs lam gyi bde drod sbar ba/ rlung gi rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud sgyu lus dang rmi lam sbyang ba/ thig le'i rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud 'od gsal bzung ba dang 'pho ba sbyang ba| de gsum gyi mjug sdud dri chen dri chu'i sbyor ba la brten nas bar do'i 'khrul ba bcad pa dang drug go// dang po rtsa'i rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud thabs lam gyi bde drod sbar ba la/

sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ rang nyid ngo bo rdo rje 'chang la rnam pa rtsa dbu ma sngon por gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma sku rdo rje dkar po/ mgrin par bla ma gsung rdo rje dmar po| snying khar bla ma thugs rdo rje sngon po rnams rdor dril 'dzin pas yum rdo rje phag mo rang mdog 'dra ba la 'khyud par bsgoms nas gsol ba btab pas/ mgrin pa'i bla ma gsung rdo rje'i mgrin pa'i a shad las me 'bar tshangs bug nas mar nyug nyug byung bas bla ma sku rdo rje yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi bab/ bla ma gsung rdo rje'i tshangs bug tu byon nas bla ma gsung rdo rje yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bab bla ma thugs rdo rje'i spyi bor thim/ slar yang bla ma sku rdo rje 'od du zhu gsung rdo rje la thim/ gsung rdo rje 'od du zhu thugs rdo rje la thim/ snying ga'i bla ma thugs rdo rje yab yum bde ba'i rnam 'gyur shig shig yod pa la sems gtad/ mthar thug rdo rje 'chang yum yab la thim/ yab rtsa dbu ma la thim/ dbu ma gsal dwangs rnyog med la yid rtse gcig tu gtad par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can la brten nas me gso ba dang*/ raṃ yig me'i 'khor lo la brten nas me sbar ba/ srog thur rnal 'byor la brten nas gtum mo gos su gyon pa/ byang sems 'bar 'dzag la brten nas bla ma'i gtum mo sgom pa rnams so// dang po rlung gzhu'i dbyibs can la brten nas me gso ba ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur mdun du brgyangs la dmigs pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ mdun rlung gzhu/ rgyab rlung gzhu rgyud/ mchog ma gnyis la rlung gi ba dan re yod pa/ gzhu rgyud de lte 'og tu yod pa'i steng du rgyab dang*/ mdun dang*/ g.yas g.yon bzhir raṃ yig re re yod pa'i dbus su gzhu rgyud kyi steng du dbu ma'i nang du gtum mo a shad/
