ngo bo bde ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ kha dog dmar ba/ rtse mo rno zhing 'khyogs pa ste me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du gsal ba/ raṃ yig bzhi las ye shes kyi me'i zil pa phrom phrom 'phro ba/ a shad las kyang me 'bar la khad yod pa la sems gtad la rlung bum can 'dzin no// gnyis pa raṃ yig me'i 'khor lo la brten nas me sbar ba ni/ lus gnad me thab drug bcings byas la/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor la rgyab rlung brdzangs pas rlung gi ba dan g.yos/ raṃ dang a shad las me 'bar dbu ma'i nang brgyud bu ga dgu nas me lce dmar nyug nyug thon yod par bsam mo// gsum pa srog thur gyi sbyor ba la brten nas gtum mo gos su gyon pa ni/ spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis khu tshur pus mo gnyis la gtad la/ dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyi rlung bcug pas raṃ yig dang a shad las me 'bar tshangs bug nas thon me lce tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du sleb par bsam/ slar yang steng rlung rngub lag pa'i khu tshur gnyis gyen du bsgrengs shing slar pus mgor bzhag pas/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas me lce thams cad mar 'khyil nas rang gi lus thams cad btums nas me lce dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la tug tug song bar sgom zhing 'bad do// bzhi pa byang sems 'bar 'dzag la brten nas bla ma'i gtum mo bsgom pa ni/ lus gnad sems skyil lag pa gnyis dpung pa gnyis la bkab/ gru mo gnyis gshib snying kha thur du mnan la/ dmigs pa sngar ltar gsal ba la raṃ yig bzhi po gcig la gcig thim/ raṃ yig gcig tu song ba la rlung rtsol byas pas/ a shad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gcig tu gyur pa dbu thur du bstan zhing bha ga gyen du bstan pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i spyi bor raṃ yig de yod pa las me 'bar rnal 'byor ma'i tshangs bug nas zhugs pas ngo bo byang sems dmar po la rnam pa me rta rnga tsam zhig rnal 'byor ma'i bha ga nas thon te dbu ma'i nang brgyud yar 'bar/

rang gi tshangs bug nas thon/ spyi bo'i he ru ka rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi gsang gnas su zhugs pas yab kyi dkar cha bab/ yum gyi bha gar zhugs pas yab yum gnyis ka bde ba'i rnam 'gyur g.yo bar bsam/ slar yang yum gyi bha ga nas dmar cha bab/ de'i ngang las rdo rje 'chang yab yum snyoms 'jug mdzad kyin dbu ma'i lam nas mar byon/ snying khar zhugs pa'i tshe yum gyi dmar cha de gsang ba'i rnal 'byor ma la phog pa tsam gyis rnal 'byor ma'ang bde ba'i nyams dang ldan par bsams la 'bad do// gsum pa mjug dang po ḍoṃ bhi pa'i 'dug stangs la brten nas snang ba dbang du bsdu ba ni/ lus gnad rkang g.yon bskums pa 'bras bu'i rtsar sbyar ba| g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i steng du lag g.yas khu tshur byas la brkyang*/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur rkang pa g.yon pa'i brla khug tu bzhag la/ dmigs pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu a shad du song*/ he ru ka yar byon spyi bor bzhugs/ dbu ma gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du bzhag cing phyi snod dbu ma nang bcud he ru ka yab yum du dag par bsgom mo// gnyis pa seng gdong ma'i 'dug stangs la brten nas gling bzhi dbang du sdud pa zhes sam rkang mgyogs bya ba ni/ rang nyid seng gdong mar bsgoms la rkang mthil du khrung khrung gi sgo nga'i sprin dkar dang sbrang smyon sbyar la byug /rkang pa'i sor mo rnams rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu lta bu yaṃ gyis mtshan pa re bris la rlung gis bar snang la bteg 'gro bar bsam mo// de dag ni gtum mo'i skor rnams so| |gnyis pa rlung gi rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud sgyu lus dang rmi lam bzung ba'i dang po rgyab rlung la brten nas sgyu lus sbyang ba la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom zhing nges par 'chi ba bsam pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus dung ba bya/ cis kyang dgos pa med par bsams la/

lus gnad tsog pu lag gnyis khu tshur sa la btsugs rkang pa btsugs/ raksha srin po'i 'bros 'ded la sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ drag po'i sbyor ba sngon song nas// ye shes mda' yi sbyor ba bya// zhes gsungs pas/ drag po'i sbyor ba ni sngar rgyab rlung sbyangs pa sngon du song ba de yin no// ye shes mda' yi sbyor ba ni/ lus gnad bsgur nas pus mo gnyis kyi steng du khu tshur bkab la rgyab thur drangs shing dmigs pa ni/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i nang du dbu ma yar sne lce chung dang mar sne 'og sgor zug pa'i snying kha'i dbus su gsang ba 'dus pa/ shar du 'khor lo sdom pa/ lhor ma hā mā yā/ nub tu dgyes pa rdo rje/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams rigs lnga tshoms su bsgom/ lte ba'i dbus su lha dang de la bskor nas 'gro ba rigs lnga/ bcud thog mar srin zhal du phul bas lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yang drangs pas 'gro ba rigs drug las 'od 'phros pa'i sne la mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa phul bar bsams la 'dren/ mthar 'gro ba rigs drug rnams la dag pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i lha tshogs rnams kyang dag pa'i sgyu ma ste/ don du dag pa dang ma dag pa gang yang sgyu ma lta bu las dngos su grub pa med par thag bcad la/ rgyal ba rigs lnga 'gro ba rigs drug la thim pas 'gro drug rgyal ba rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'gro ba rigs drug dbu ma la thim pas phyi ltar na dbu ma ma dag pa'i sgyu ma bden med/ nang ltar na bstan pa'i gtso bo gser btso ma lta bu'ang dben par ma grub pa dag pa'i sgyu ma ste/ don du thams cad sgyu ma lta bu la'ang sgyu lus gsal dwangs rnyog pa med par sems gtad la 'bad pas sgom zhing mtshan mo'ang de ltar bya'o// gnyis pa mdun rlung la brten nas rmi lam sbyang ba la gsum ste/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ bla ma la mos gus sngon du btang*/ sbyor ba gsum ni rtsa 'od kar bsgyur ba/ rlung 'od kar bsgyur ba/ thig le 'od kar bsgyur ba gsum las/ dang po rtsa 'od kar bsgyur ba ni/ lus gan rkyal byas la rkang mthil gnyis sar btsugs la sngar bshad pa'i cho gas rdo rje thur ma'i sbyor bas padma rakta'am| ma rnyed na lug gro mo'i khrag mang nyung ran tsam drangs la bag zhi 'khrab cing sbyang ngo*/ gnyis pa rlung 'od kar bsgyur ba ni/ pi pi'i sbyor bas thur sel dbang du sdud// rtsa gnyis mal chug ye shes dbu mar gzhug /myur du mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i don te/ lus gnad pus gnyis rkang sor sa la btsugs/ lag gnyis khu tshur sa la btsugs/ rgyab la ka 'dzugs kyi rlung bcug la mdun la rlung bcug /spyi bo sa la btsugs/ rdo rje skyil krung gnam du bcas la ka 'dzugs g.yas skor g.yon skor byas la rgyab tu 'bud do// gsum pa thig le 'od kar bsgyur ba ni/ rlung gnyis gyen log thig le dbang du 'du// rtsa yig gsal bas haṃ yig gnas su thim// myur du mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur| |zhes gsungs pa la/ lus gnad pus gnyis rkang sor sa la btsugs// lag gnyis bsnol ba'i gru mo sa la btsugs// dpral ba lag gnyis bsnol ba'i steng du bzhag |dmigs pa ni/ rang lus kyi nang du rtsa dbu ma gnyis mdun ma dkar po'i mar sne na thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig yod pa/ rgyab tu dbu ma ser po'i mar sne thig le smug po gcig yod par bsgom/ ka ba gcig pas drag tu 'then pas smad kyi thig le gnyis la kā di dmar po bzhi bcu yar phreng byas nas snying khar slebs/ yang spyi bo'i haṃ las 'phros pa'i ā di dkar po bcu drug mar phreng byas nas snying khar slebs/ de'i tshe rgya mtsho brag la sbyar ka ba gcig pas drag tu 'then pas smad kyi thig le gnyis ā di kā di la thim/

yang 'then pas ā di bcu drug kā di bzhi bcu la thim/ kā di rnams spyi bo'i haṃ la thim/ haṃ yig rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gcig tu gyur nas spyi bo nas sor bzhi tsam thon yod par bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ 'og thur sel la brten nas rmi lam btsan thabs su bzung ba/ steng srog rtsol la brten nas rmi lam btsan thabs su bzung ba/ bar zung 'jug la brten nas rmi lam btsan thabs su bzung ba'o| |dang po la gnyis te/ rgyab rlung la brten pa dang mdun rlung la brten pa'o// dang po rgyab rlung la brten pa ni/ rlung gi gzhu la hūm̐ gi mda'// thig le spyi bo'i haṃ la thim// gyad 'then seng ge rtsal sprug dang*// pi pi'i sbyor bas thig le haṃ la thim// zhes pa la/ lus gnad sems dkyil lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la btsugs/ dmigs pa dbu ma'i mar sne'i thig le hūm̐ gi rnam pa de thur sel gyi rlung gis spyi bo'i haṃ la thim par bsam zhing*/ ka ba gcig pas drangs la g.yas 'then g.yon 'then byed kyin dkrugs te drangs la nyal bas rmi lam zin to// 'di ni gyad kyi 'then thabs seng ge rtsal sprug bya/ zhes pa'i don no// gnyis pa mdun rlung la brten nas rmi lam bzung ba ni/ phag zhal gyen 'dren drag po'i sbyor ba bya// zhes pas/ lus gnad gan rkyal rkang mthil gnyis sar btsugs la/ lgang phu'i sbyor bas dang po chu dang de nas rlung bcug la rdo rje'i rtsa ba skud pas bkyigs la langs te/ rgya mtsho ltag 'then gyis thur du phul la khu tshur gnyis dpyi zur du brgyangs la thur du drag tu phul la/ slar yang chu dang rlung gnyis phyir btang ste gnyid log pas rmi lam zin to// gnyis pa steng srog rtsol la brten nas rmi lam bzung ba ni/ gsum yig la brten bdud rtsi thur du 'bebs// rin chen kha che dbang chen sa gzhir thim// zhes pa la/ lus gnad tsog pu lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la brgyang*/

dmigs pa spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi dkar po thur du byon nas lce chung gi gsum yig la thim/ rgyab kyi dbu ma dkar po'i nang du bdud rtsi dkar po bab bshang lam nas thon/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thim par mos la rlung thur du phul/ de nas nyal bas rmi lam zin to// 'di ni/ 'khor lo bcud ldan ye shes rlung gis brgyan// rtsa mchog bdud rtsi thigs pa rang gnas bzung*// bde stong 'khor lo'i rtsa las grol bar gyur// ces pa'i don te/ gnyid log khar chang zhim po lan gsum bskol la lgang phu'i sbyor bas mdun du drangs/ bcud mi 'tsho na srin po raksha bya/ lte ba'i thad dang rdo rje tsha grabs byed na rdo rje bro rdung dang lag mthil gnyis kyi 'grul mang du bya'o// gsum pa bar rlung zung 'jug la brten nas rmi lam bzung ba ni/ steng 'og rgyu ba rab bkag nas// zung 'jug rlung la gnad du bsnun// ye shes rlung dang 'gyur ba nyid// mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis pus mgor bkab/ rlung bum can bzung la nam thub thub bzung mi thub pa'i dus yang yang brngubs la gzhil/ de nas rlung btang la nyal khar dbu ma'i nang du sems gtad la nyal bas rmi lam zin to// gsum pa rjes ni/ lus gnad bdun ldan mig gnyis sna rtser phab// āḥyig gsal bas hūm̐ yig rab tu 'bar// nyi zla gsal btab dbu ma'i nang du thim// myur du mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'i dmigs pa ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar la/ rang gi lte bar padma 'dab bzhi ser po 'dab ma re re'i steng du āḥre re/ dbus su hūm̐ zhig bsam| hūm̐ de las 'od zer sngon po 'phros pa āḥbazhi po la phog pas sangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma kī/ gos dkar mo/ dam tshig sgrol ma bzhi bzhugs pa la/ slar yang sangs rgyas spyan ma mā ma kī la thim/ mā ma kī gos dkar mo la thim/

gos dkar mo dam tshig sgrol ma la thim/ dam tshig sgrol ma hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ dbu ma la thim/ dbu ma'i yar sne zla ba mar sne nyi ma gsal ba las nyi zla gnyis che ru song bas phyi snod nang bcud thams cad nyi zla gnyis so so'i nang du tshud par bsams la/ rlung bum can bzung la nyal bas rmi lam zin par 'gyur ro// de thams cad du rmi lam ma zin na thun mong ma yin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten pa ni/ rang gi dbu ma'i nang du mgrin pa'i thad du padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i ze'u 'bru la dbus su rdo rje 'chang yab yum/ shar du rnam snang*/ lhor rin 'byung*/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don grub rnams gsal btab la/ de la sems ma yeng bar byas la nyal te gnyid pas rmi lam zin pa la the tshom med do// gsum pa thig le'i rtsa 'dab kyi mjug sdud 'od gsal bzung ba dang 'pho ba sbyang ba gnyis/ dang po 'od gsal la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ bla ma bsgoms la mos gus sngon du btang ste/ rtsa yig gsal ba rnal 'byor ma ru gsal// āḥyig gsal ba haṃ yig gnas su thim// zhes pa/ rang lus rdo rje 'chang du bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma rnal 'byor ma ru bsgoms pa'i yar sne rtsa zhal zhi ba/ mar sne phag zhal drag po/ rdo rje'i lte ba ru āḥyig dkar po zhig yod par bsgom/ spyi bor haṃ yig cig gsal btab/ ka ba gcig pa'i rlung gnad byas pas āḥyig haṃ la thim par bsgom/ mthar rnal 'byor ma haṃ la thim/ haṃ dmigs med du song bar bsgom/ da byid kyi sha| nya ral pa khrab can gyi sha/ mchil pa'i sha/ de pho'i sha rnams zhib tu btags la 'o ma dang sbyar/ lgang phu'i sbyor ba sogs kyis mdun nas drangs pas khams 'phel ba'i dgos pa yod do| |gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ zung 'jug la brten lba bar phab// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mchod byas nas// slar yang rang lus bsdus nas khyab par bya/

myur du mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ smyug ma tshigs can kha che chung bha ga kheg pa zhig gis rig ma'i bha ga bkag la bar spra tshil gyis bsdams nas/ smyug ma che ba de'i sgab na smyug ma'i sbu gu chung ba bug pa chung ngu yod pa zhig brdzangs la rlung bcug cing brdzangs pas yum gyi bha ga na gsang ba 'dus pa lha sum cu so gnyis yod pa la mchod pa phul/ yum gyi ka ba gcig pas khag sgra dang bcas yum gyi zhal nas byung*/ yang yum gyi bha ga nas rlung gis phul yab kyi ka ba gcig pas drangs pas khag sgra dang bcas pas yab kyi zhal du phyung ba'o| |yang*/ dben gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mchog tu// mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs par byas nas ni// rtsa gnyis kha sbyor 'khor lo kha sbyor gyis// thig le 'bar 'dzag dga' bzhi 'bros 'ded bya// zur du phab la bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mchod// zag med bde ba chen po bsgoms byas na// 'pho med bde ba chen po 'thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ dur khrod la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su rang gi rdo rje hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ rig ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i padma āḥlas padma a yig gis mtshan par bsgom/ rtsa gnyis kha sbyor zhes pa la/ pho mo kha sbyor/ rtsa kha sbyor/ rlung kha sbyor/ thig le kha sbyor ma bu bzhi zhes pa'o// 'khor lo kha sbyor zhes pa la/ rang gi lte bar bde mchog lha lnga yab yum/ snying khar kyai rdo rje yab yum lha lnga/ mgrin par ma hā mā yā lha lnga yab yum/ spyi bor mi bskyod pa yab yum rnams gsal btab bo// rig ma'ang de 'dra bar gsal btab bo// thabs kyi yul snang lta ba la/ rang gi spyi bo'i haṃ yig las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig byon pa las/ 'od kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i lha rnams mun khung du sgron me bteg pa bzhin khra lam mer bsgom/ yum rang yang de 'drar bsgom/

lus gnad rig ma gan rkyal byas pa'i bha gar rdo rje bcug la rang kha sbub byas/ thig le rang dang rig ma kha sbyar la rang rang gi yul snang la blta'o// bsrub pa sogs mi bya/ thig le srub/ thig le 'bar 'dzag ces lus gnad rang gi gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug /rig ma'i g.yon 'og tu bcug la kha sbyor bya/ rang dang rig ma gnyis kyis rig ma'i bcu drug mdud sa nas mdzub mo brgyad kyis nang du bsdus la bsrub/ dga' bzhi 'bros 'ded bya/ zhes pa la/ dga' bzhi 'bros 'ded thig le dkar dmar gnyis phab la rang gi byang sems dkar pos rig ma'i lha rnams la mchod pa phul/ rang gis rig ma'i yul snang blta/ rig ma'i byang sems dmar pos yab kyi lha rnams la mchod pa phul/ rig mas yab kyi yul snang blta'o// yab kyi byang sems dkar pos yum rnams mchod/ yum gyi dmar chas yab rnams mchod/ thur du phab nas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni yab yum gnyis pos lus kyi lha rnams mchod pa'o// lus lha dang*/ ngag sngags dang*/ yid ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes bya'o// yar la spyan drangs thabs kyi dkyil 'khor mchod// ces pa ni/ lugs ldog tu spyan drangs la rang lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ e waṃ zung 'jug thabs shes 'bros 'ded kyis// shes rab padma mchog la reg byas nas// thabs kyi rdo rje nor bu'i bum pa bkang*// a wa dhū ti nyi zla dgram par bya// zhes pa la/ e waṃ ni thabs shes gnyis/ nyi zla ni byang sems dkar dmar/ shes rab padma mchog la reg byas nas thabs kyi nor bu'i bum pa byang sems kyis 'geng pa'o// a wa dhū ti nyi zla dgram par bya// zhes pa ni/ dbu ma'i nang du byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa yin no// gsum pa rjes ni/ glang chen rdo rje 'chang dang stag mo'i ngar// gcan gzan skyug dang wa mo'i snom// lte ba snying kha mgrin pa dang*// spyi gtsug dag tu rim bzhin drang*// zhes pa las/

glang chen hing ni/ rig ma gan rkyal du byas la/ rang yang kha sbub byas la rig ma'i spyi bo nas/ rang gi lag pa'i gung mdzub gnyis kyis bskyod la bsrub/ rdo rje 'chang ni/ rig ma gan rkyal rang kha sbubs kyi lag pas 'khyud la rig ma'i sked pa la rang gi lag pa bsnol bas so// stag mo'i ngar la/ rig ma'i lus gnad gong ltar la/ rang gi lag pa rig ma'i ske'i thad phan tshun sa la btsugs/ gcan gzan skyug la/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ rang gi lag pa gnyis kyi khu tshur nu steng du bya/ wa'i snom la/ lus gnad gong ltar la/ rang gi lag pa gnyis pos rig ma'i lag gnyis bsdus nas bya'o// de nas seng ge rnam rol gyis 'grems byed do// de ltar byas pas gzhi lam gyi 'od gsal la re mi dgos par skad cig de nyid la 'bras bu'i 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du byed par gdon mi za'o| |gnyis pa 'pho ba la/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis/ de'ang gang 'pho na kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'di 'pho/ gang du 'pho na sems nyid chos sku'i ngang du 'pho/ tshul ji ltar du 'pho na 'jag tshugs ma dang*/ mdzub skyel ma dang*/ rlung 'jug bde ba'i tshul dang gsum mo// dang po 'jag tshugs ma ni/ 'chi ba rgyud brten zhen med sbyin par btang*// nor bu gsal btab āḥyig gnas su thim// sems nyid 'og min gnas su 'pho byas na// myur du mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur// zhes pa'ang rang lus tha mal pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa'i sne mor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying khar rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo āḥyig zhig gsal btab la phaṭa mang du brgyab pa'i tshe āḥyig mgrin pa sogs nas yar 'phang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mtheb la tug tug song bar bsam mo// thun 'jog khar āḥyig snying khar phab la bzhag go// las sbyor ni/ lus la phyi mig mi blta bar rgyangs kyis rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar 'pho'o// gnyis pa mdzub skyel ma la gnyis te/

rgyab rlung la brten pa dang*/ mdun rlung la brten pa gnyis las/ dang po rgyab rlung la brten pa'i mdzub skyel ma ni/ rlung gi gzhu la hūm̐ gi mda'// sems nyid 'og min gnas su thim// mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur| |zhes pa la/ lus gnad pus mo gnyis rkang sor sa la btsugs/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la bzhag /dmigs pa rang nyid kyi sems nyid hūm̐ yig bshang lam la yod par bsgom| snying padma 'dab bzhi pa'i dbus su rdo rje 'chang yab yum/ 'dab ma shar du spyan ma/ lhor mā ma kī/ nub tu gos dkar mo/ byang du dam tshig sgrol ma rnams bsam/ ka ba gcig pa byas la hūm̐ yar 'ong rdo rje 'chang la thim pas rdo rje 'chang gi sku las 'od zer yum la phog /yum las 'od 'phros/ lha mo bzhi la phog pas spyan ma mā ma kī la thim/ mā ma kī gos dkar mo la thim/ gos dkar mo dam tshig sgrol ma la thim/ dam tshig sgrol ma yum la thim/ yum rdo rje 'chang la thim/ rdo rje 'chang 'od du zhu ba byang sems dkar dmar gnyis su gyur pa'i dbus na rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ bcug la/ sems ma yeng bar gtad/ las sbyor gyi dus byang sems dkar dmar hūm̐ dang bcas pa rgyab rlung ka 'dzugs kyis drangs pas spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang bzhugs pa'i thugs kar 'phang la rtse gcig tu sgom zhing lus la ma chags par bya'o// gnyis pa mdun rlung la brten pa'i mdzub skyel ma ni/ rlung gi gzhu la āḥyi mda'// sems nyid ye shes ngang du thim| |padma'i 'ja' lus thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ lus gnad tsog pu la/ dmigs pa lte 'og sor bzhir rang gi rnam shes āḥdakar po dang snying khar padma'i dbus su rdo rje 'chang yab yum gsal btab la/ mdun rlung gi sbyor bas lte 'og gi a yig rdo rje 'chang la thim pas yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du zhu nas byang sems dkar dmar 'ja' tshon dkar dmar dang bcas te rang gi snying nang du khra bun ne yod pa'ang snying dang 'ja' tshon rgya che ru song bas/

phyi nang snod bcud thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi nang du tshud nas thams cad 'ja' tshon du yod par bsgom/ las sbyor dus 'ja' tshon thams cad tshur 'dus snying khar thim/ spyi bor rdo rje 'chang yab yum bsgoms la/ mdun rlung gi sbyor bas snying nang gi byang sems dkar dmar 'ja' tshon dang bcas pa tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis thon/ rdo rje 'chang gi thugs kar thim pa la sems gtad la ma yeng bar bya/ lus la phyi mig mi blta bar 'pho'o// gsum pa rlung 'jug pa bde ba'i tshul gyis 'pho ba ni/ rlung gi gzhu la dbang po'i mda'// sems nyid chos sku'i ngang du 'pho// mchog gi mkha' spyod thob par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ lus gnad sems skyil lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du sa la brgyang*/ dmigs pa ni/ rang lus dbu ma'i nang du snying gar rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le zhig gnas pa tshangs bug dbu ma'i yar sner rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal btab la/ rlung bum can stod du dril zhing hika gis bskul bas thig le tshangs bug nas thon la khad yod par sbyang*/ las sbyor ni/ thig le hika dang rlung gis drag tu phul bas tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis thon/ rdo rje 'chang ngam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar thim par bsam/ lus la ma chags pa gal che'o// 'pho ba 'di thams cad sbyang dus thun 'jog khar kas 'bebs/ de ltar byas pas sdig po che mtshams med lnga byas pa zhig kyang lam 'di dang 'phrad na 'tshang rgya ba gdon mi za bas ma bsgom pa da lta nyid du rnal 'byor pa lus rgya zhig pa dang 'tshang rgya ba lhan cig tu bya ba'i thabs shin tu zab pa 'pho ba'i gdams pa zhes bya ba dag go// gsum pa dri chen dri chu'i sbyor ba la brten nas bar do'i 'khri ba gcod pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ rgyab mdun gyi thur ma gang ltar byang zhing chub par bya'o// mi rtag 'chi ba sngon song nas// bde chen gyen ldog rlung gi sbyor ba bya| |rgya mtsho dkrug rdeb me rlung gnas su drangs// zhes pa la/

thog mar chos thams cad 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i chos can du thag rbad kyis bcad la/ lus gnad pus mo gnyis rkang sor sar btsugs la/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdun du sar btsugs la/ dmigs pa/ rang gi snying khar rgyal ba rigs lnga lte bar 'gro drug bsgom/ thog mar thur nas phul bas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku las 'od zer 'phros/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ yang ka ba gcig btsugs pas thur sel gyen du drangs pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi snyigs ma sbyangs| dwangs ma'i 'od zer gyi sne la mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byon rgyal ba lnga la mchod pa phul lo// rgya mtsho dkrug rdeb ni/ mo rlung brngubs nas sems skyil rgya mtsho dkrug cing rdeb bo| |de'i rdzogs rim ni/ 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i snyigs ma dag nas dwangs ma'i lus rgyal ba rigs lnga la thim par bsam mo// yang*/ rgyab rlung dag gi rgyu ba rab bkag ste// mdun rlung me rlung gnas su spyan drangs nas// myur du las rlung dag las grol bar 'gyur// zhes pa'ang bcud dang 'o ma bsres la mdun nas drang*/ dmigs pa rgyab rlung ltar gsal btab bo| |gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ mchog gi dbu ma gsal byas nas// yid bzhin nor bu gsal btab ste// thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gsal byas nas// gsang gnas thig le gsal btab ste| |spyi bo'i haṃ phab yar la drangs// gnyis su med par bstim byas na// ye shes rdo rje rtogs par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ lus gnad sngar ltar la/ dmigs pa/ dbu ma ser po yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ yar sne'i steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi spyi bor haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ gsang gnas na 'gro ba rigs drug gi sa bon thig le dmar po cog sgong tsam zhig bsgoms la/ mar phab ces pa/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi sngon po mar bab/

dbu ma'i nang brgyud thig le dmar po la phog pas rigs drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ka ba gcig pa'i rlung gis thig le dmar po yar drangs la haṃ la thim/ haṃ dang thig le dmar po gnyis ka yar drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ rnal 'byor ma la thim/ rnal 'byor ma dbu ma la thim par bsam mo// mdun rlung la/ bde chen thabs kyi sbyor ba yis// he ru ka la mchod 'then bya// zhes pa/ lus gnad rlung gnad bcud 'o ma lgang bu'i sbyor ba sogs gong dang 'dra'o// thur sel gyen log rlung gi sbyor ba bya// zag med bdud rtsis tshim byas ye shes rdo rje rtogs par 'gyur// zhes pa la/ bcud 'o ma dang ka ba gcig pa'i rlung gnad kyis srin zhal du thur ma bcug nas drang*/ lus gnad sems skyil byas la drang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go// rtsa ma lus pa 'dus par byed pa la/ thur sel gyen 'dren 'khor 'dren gnas su drang*// bde chen rlabs gnyis rang gnas gnas su gnas// myur du rtsa rnams grol ba nyid du 'gyur| |zhes pa la/ lus gnad pus mo gnyis rkang sor sa la btsugs/ lag gnyis khu tshur mdun sa mnan/ ka ba gcig pa'i rlung gnad kyis drag tu brngubs la drangs pas bum pa can gyi lag pa gnyis pos brla gnyis nas mnan la rba rlabs lus gnad ma zhig pa'i ngang nas rdeg go// rlung ma 'khyil ba 'khyil bar byed pa la/ dbu ma gyen ldog ro 'dzin nor bu 'jigs| |dbang po mchog bsgrad long bu gyen la ldog /nang rlung rgyu ba rab bkag nas// bde chen hika gis drang bar bya// zhes pa la/ lus gnad spyi bo sa la btsugs la rkang mthil gnam la bstan/ lag gnyis gru mo sa la btsugs/ lag mthil gnyis pos mkhal ma gnyis bkab la bshang lam rkang btsugs la ka ba gcig pas hika sgra dang bcas pas drag tu 'then no// mig bsgrad lce rtse rkan la sbyar la drag tu 'then par bya'o// sems ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa la// thabs shes lus gnad ldan byas nas// sems nyid shel gong lta bur gsal byas te// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog kun bral te// mi rtog ye shes skye bar 'gyur/

lus gnad sems dpa'i skyil krung la/ sems gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i spros med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du yud tsam rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog go// gsum pa rjes la/ bde chen rgyal po thabs shes rlung la sbyang*// zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis tshim byas nas// ye shes rdo rje zhes bya rtogs par 'gyur| |zhes pa la/ bcud 'o ma bshang lam rkang bcud ka ba gcig pas drag tu drangs la/ lus gnad sems skyil skyil krung steng du bzhag la spros med gnas lugs kyi steng du ma yeng bar bsgom| thabs steng rlung shes rab 'og rlung yin no// de ltar rgyab mdun gyi rlung 'jug gi dmigs pa la brten nas bar do'i 'khri ba btsan thabs su bcad pas grol lam pa lta bu'i skye gnas bar do/ srid pa bar do/ 'chi ba bar do sogs grangs mang po phreng ba la bgrangs nas don ci'ang ma rtogs par ba glang ltar 'chi ba lta bu de mi dgos par/ shi ma thag bar do dang po la longs sku nges pa lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang skad cig la thob par gdon mi za ba'i thabs bar do'i gdams pa zhes bya ba dag go// da ni las phran bu'i gdams pa steng 'og bar gsum la brten nas gegs sel zhing tshe sgrub bya ba'i thabs bum can gsum bsgom pa ni/ steng srog rtsol la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can dang*/ 'og thur sel la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can dang/ srog thur gnyis ka la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can dang gsum mo// dang po/ steng srog rtsol la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can bsgom pa ni/ rang gzhi lus rdo rje 'chang du gsal ba'i lus kyi dkyil na yar rtsa dbu ma gsal btab/ snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i thig le dkar dmar yungs 'bru tsam gnyis gsal btab/ rang gi spyi bo nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/

phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse dang nus mthu thams cad dang*/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi nas gzugs med khams kyi bar la gnas pa'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsdus te/ steng rlung srog rtsol gyi rlung drangs pa dang mnyam du lus kyi nang nas mar la zhugs pas/ snying gi byang chub sems kyi thig le dkar dmar la thim pas/ de gnyis kyang 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan du gyur pa de nyid kyis lus kyi nang thams cad ma lus pa gang zhing khyab pa la sems gtad nas nyin mtshan thams cad du bsgom mo| |gnyis pa/ 'og thur sel la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can ni/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer sngon po 'og phyogs su 'phros pas/ klu dga' bo/ 'jog po la sogs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsdus/ thur sel gyi rlung dang lhan cig tu srin zhal nas yar drangs dbu ma'i nang gi thig le gnyis po la thim| de gnyis kyang 'od du zhu nas rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyis lus kyi nang thams cad khrigs mer gyis khengs pa la sems gtad nas bsgom/ gsum pa/ srog thur gnyis ka la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i bum can bsgom pa ni/ rang gi gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ khams gsum dang srid pa gsum gyi tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal 'byor thams cad rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bsdus te srog rtsol nas ye shes kyi rlung kha dog dkar po'i rnam par nang du spyan drangs snying ga'i thig le gnyis la thim/ 'og thur sel nas ye shes kyi rlung kha dog dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs snying ga'i thig le gnyis la thim/

thig le gnyis nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang nas rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo dri med shel sgong dwangs pa ltar phyi gsal nang gsal du 'dug pa la sems gtad nas bsgom mo// slar yang de nyid thams cad las rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros pas/ rang gi lus rtsa khams dang bcas pa thams cad rlung 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan gyis khrigs mer gyis gang ba la sems gtad la 'bad pas bsgom mo// de rnams ni sgom pa'i dmigs pa'o// dmigs pa de gsum gyi lus gnad ni/ sems skyil tsog pu dang langs pa nyal ba sogs gang bder bya'i nges pa med do// rlung gnad ni/ gong ltar srog dang thur sel so so'i bum can 'dzin pa dang de nyid kha sbyor du 'dzin pa'o// 'di rnams kyi lag len mthong ba rgyud pa las shes so// gdams pa ni/ rlung la brten pa'i tshe sgrub bla na med pa'ang yin la| rdo rje lus kyi rtsa mdud zhig cing rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa dang rtsa rlung thig le'i lam gyi gegs sel zhing bogs 'don pa'i gdams pa bla na med pa yin zhes bla ma dag gis gsungs so| |de ltar sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten nas rtsa rlung thig le gsum gyi rtsa 'dab dang*/ so so'i mjug sdud du chos drug dang*/ las phran bu tshe sgrub gegs sel dang bcas pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba/ rlung rtsol 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa la brten nas mtshan ldan bla ma dam pas ji ltar bstan pa ltar snod ldan gyi slob ma dam pas yid gnyis dang the tshom gyi 'ching ba las legs par grol bar byas te mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang bcas te nyams su blang ba'i phan yon dang 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ ji skad du/ ye shes lnga ni rab thob nas| |rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang brnyes// zhes pa ste/ gnas skabs su sku rdo rje'i khrid la brten nas sbyang gzhi lus kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba la bum dbang*/

sbyang 'bras bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing mthar thug lus snang stong chu zla lta bur go/ sa dang po rab tu dga' ba dang*/ gnyis pa dri ma med pa/ gsum pa 'od byed pa rnams 'thob/ tshogs lam mngon du gyur/ rtogs pa ni rtse gcig gsum skye/ sprul sku'i go 'phang 'thob/ gsung rdo rje'i khrid la brten nas sbyang gzhi ngag gi sgrib pa dang rtsa rlung thig le'i snyigs ma ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sa bon du gyur pa rnams sbyangs/ sbyong byed gsang dbang rtsa'i rtsa 'dab/ rlung gi rtsa 'dab/ thig le'i rtsa 'dab gsum/ sbyangs 'bras gsung sngags kyi rim pa bzla ba la dbang*/ mthar thug ngag grag stong brag cha lta bur mthong zhing*/ sa bzhi pa 'od 'phro ba dang*/ lnga pa sbyang dka' ba/ drug pa mngon du gyur pa/ bdun pa ring du song ba rnams 'thob/ lam mthong lam mngon du 'gyur/ rtogs pa ni spros bral gsum mngon du 'gyur/ longs sku'i go 'phang 'thob/ thugs rdo rje'i khrid la brten nas sbyang gzhi yid kyi sgrib pa glo bur ba/ sbyong byed shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rnam par mi rtog pa/ sbyangs 'bras thugs phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug sems gsal stong 'dzin med gzha' tshon lta bur go/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba dang*/ dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros/ bcu pa chos kyi sprin rnams 'thob/ lam sbyor lam mngon du 'gyur/ rtogs pa ro gcig gsum rgyud la skye/ chos sku'i go 'phang 'thob/ mjug sdud chos drug dang rang gzhan gyi lus lde mig dang thabs ldan la brten nas sbyang gzhi shes bya'i dri ma phra mo rnams sbyangs/ sbyong byed dbang bzhi pa rig ma'i lus rgya la brten nas brjod med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de kho na nyid/ sbyangs 'bras stong pa'i 'od gsal rang rig bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes bsgom pa la dbang*/ mthar thug sems rang rig rang gsal brjod bral tho rangs kyi nam mkha' slong byed kyi rkyen gsum dang bral ba lta bur go/

sa bcu gcig pa kun tu 'od dang*/ bcu gnyis dpe med pa/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa 'thob/ lam sgom lam mngon du 'gyur| rtogs pa ni sgom du med pa gsum rgyud la skye/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'thob la/ mthar thug rnal 'byor pa lus rgya grol ma thag bar do dang po'i skad cig ma de nyid la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nges pa lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes skyon thams cad ma dag pa med cing yon tan thams cad dang mi ldan pa med pa de lta bu 'thob par gdon mi za la/ de thob nas gdul bya rigs can gsum la sogs pa thams cad gnas nges med rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la sogs par/ chos zab cing rgya che la zab gsal gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa sbyor lam zab mo/ dus rtag par ji srid sems can thams cad kyi khams ji srid pa de srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du phrin las rgyun chad med par 'byung ba gdon mi za ba dag ni lam zab mo 'di nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mdor bsdus nas brjod pa dag go// de ltar rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nas nye bar brgyud pa grub thob chen po rnams gshegs zin pa'i bshul lam/ ma 'ongs par 'byon par 'gyur ba'i grub chen rnams kyang gshegs pa'i lam/ da lta grub chen rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa rnams kyang gshegs bzhin pa'i lam bde bar gyur pa dbu phyag rdzogs gsum lam gyi cha lag gzhan gang la'ang ltos mi dgos par myur lam bde ba chen po lhan skyes ye shes kyi gseng lam zab pa bas ches zab pa/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po'i snyan brgyud sa ra ha dang sha wa ri dbang phyug la gdams pa'i theg pa gtso bor sbyor lam la brten nas grol lam yang zhar byung du ston par byed pa rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi khrid kyi rim pa rnams dang*/ las phran bu'i skor tshang la ma nor ba go sla zhing 'khyer bde ba phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa dad ldan slob ma rnams kyi re skong yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba rang gi nyams myong gtso bor bshad cing*/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis legs par brgyan te nyams su blang bde bar byas shing*/ lung rig gi mtha' gcod kyis rgyas par byas na blo dman rnams 'jigs kyi dogs pa'i phyir re zhig spros pa de tsam gyis chog par go// 'dir smras pa/ gsung rab mdo rgyud mtha' bral rgya mtsho g.yo lta bu che// blo gros kho bo'i ri dbang gar gyi rol rtsed las/ zab don rta bdun khri la 'jo sgeg mkhan gang yin na'ang*// snyan brgyud nam mkha'i nor bur gus pas 'dud// sa ra ha bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin dang sha wa ri zhes 'phags pa'i yul du grags pa'i gdugs dkar g.yo bar byed de'i thugs kyi chu shel me long ngogs// thub chen ston pa'i 'khor lo bar dang tha ma'i don kun bsdoms te zlum mdzad rdo rje 'chang dbang thugs kyi nying khu zab don dpyid// lhan skyes ye shes zab cing gsal ba'i don dam rdo rje gang de'i chos sku'i rang rtsal longs spyod rdzogs sku sgyu ma yi// snang brnyan cho 'phrul myur du ston byed dam chos zab mo'i gzugs brnyan shar ro grub chen khyod rnams lam 'dis grol ba kho nar nges// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang chu mtsho'i dpal// de las 'ongs pa'i man ngag dal 'gro'i rgyun// grub chen gong du bshad pa'i thugs kyi bai ḍūr de rnams kyi bum bzang du| |gang bab skal ldan 'gro blo'i dri ma rnams// 'khrud byed dag pa'i klung bzang 'di na gangs can ljongs son// 'jigs med grags dang ras chen mi pham rje'i// dam chos nges don zab mo'i sgo brgyad po// yongs 'dzin yongs 'dzin rnam 'joms phun tshogs bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan te// da lta chos kyi grags tsam las gzhan gyis nyams su len pa pa'i nyams chos rgyu| |thob par rlom pa'i bshad bshad mang po yis mi snang ngo*// bskal par 'bad kyang ngo bo ma rtogs bshad grwa tsho lta bu dang*// chos kun stong par sems pa'i chad lta yis// rtogs pa'i phu thag 'gong pos zin pa dang*// zhi gnas nas rtsam sbur ba'i 'gros lta bu// chos sku rtogs su re ba'i sdug sran dang*// rang nyams las 'phros slob ma mi 'khrid par// dpe klog nyin mtshan 'khor yug la brten nas/

/slob mar stong nyid ston pa'i ham stobs can dkar dge ba phal che ba ni snga rabs kyi lung rig tsam ma gtogs nyams myong ye med pa lta bu/ /mtshams med mngon sum spyod pa'i bshes gnyen deng sang gi 'khrug long kho na byed pa lta bu dang*/ /rang gis bsgoms pa'i nyams myong mi 'chad par// snga rabs rgan po'i tshig gi tho co la/ /legs par zhen nas 'khrid pa'i log bshes dang*| |rang gzhan stong tshul tshig gi tha snyad tsam// 'di yin med par nges don yin sems pa'i/ /nyams snang dkar dmar lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul la// ngo sprod byas nas chos skur rtogs pa rdzogs chen du bsnyad btags nas sems dang sems byung tsam yang mi shes par rbad kham chen po byed pa lta bu dang*// cho 'brang rigs rus kho na'i dpal yon rnams// thod du bcings nas sa 'bri stag 'brug sogs rigs la la lta bu slob ma 'khrid pa dang*// zab don chos rnams blta ba'i mig longs shing*// nyams myong snod du gyur pa'i bum pa chag /bde 'gror 'gro byed lam grogs 'khar ba bral// gegs sel bogs 'don dmigs bu'i tshogs med par// yun du bor dang dbang drag khe ngom dang*/ */gos rgyan bzang por gab nas slob ma deng sang gi bshes gnyen phal cher gyis bsdus// dper na mi gtsang phung por nyi tshe ba'i// sbrang ma 'du ltar blun po'i 'khor dang bcas// rang gzhan kun kyang rdo rje'i dmyal khams su// skad cig ltung ba'i thabs rtsol du ma yi// brtul zhugs 'dzin cing tshul ldan 'ga' mthong tshe// rang rgyud log pa'i dpe des sun phyung nas// srid gsum rang gi nyams su 'di lta bu ma lon pa'i phrag dog gis kho bo'i khrid gzhung 'di lta bu la gshe ba'o// khengs pa'i 'o dod rtsub ma yi// tshig gi phreng ba spel dang 'di mi mnyam// kho bos sngon nas skye ba'i phreng ba 'ga'// 'phags pa'i yul sa ra ha che ba du blangs pa nas brtsams te// da lta srid 'dir thug pa'i bar rnams su//

mtshan rnam 'joms phun tshogs ldan bla ma tshul bzhin bsten byas nas// des gsungs dam chos zab mo'i dgongs pa'i don// legs par 'doms nas de don zab mo'i tshul| |'bad pas sgom tshe bde gsal nyams tsam la// don du rlom par ma byas rtogs pa yi// phu thag bcad de rang rgyud grol bar byas// slar yang skal ldan 'ga' la phan pa'i blos// rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud zab don sbas pa'i mdzod// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam gsum po// rtsa rlung thig le'i gdams pa sbyor dngos rjes// mjug sdud chos drug phran bu tshe sgrub bcas// rang gi nyams myong bla ma'i gsung gis brgyan// mgyogs par bris nas thar 'dod yongs la byin// kye ma/ za tshogs skad cig tsam yang ma bsgoms shing*// bla mas bshad tshe thob par rab rlom ste| |dar cig 'das nas gdams pa'i gnad rnams kun// tshong 'dus mgron ltar 'dus byas spel gzhol nas// dpe nyog mang po'i mgo mjug kun dkrugs te// yig nag ngo bshus bstan bcos yin rlom nas// rang gi slob ma blun dad can 'ga' la// byin nas zom por sdod pa'i snying phod can// 'ga' tsam yod srid kho bo'i legs bshad 'di// mthong tshe smra bcad brtul zhugs longs la 'dug /sngon nas bag chags sad pa'i 'dzangs ma la// zab don snying po'i gdams pas dbang bskur zhing*// bla ma'i gsang tshig man ngag gis brgyan nas// nyams myong steng nas son pa'i dam chos 'di// skal ldan khyed rnams sngon chad som nyi yi// dpe hrul 'ga' tsam smig rgyu'i 'khrul 'khor la// ri dwags chu la rlom nas 'khrul gyur kyang*// de dag song zin da ni 'bad brtson gyis// kho bo'i legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba 'di// mos gus rgyal mtshan lhab lhub rtser zhog la// the tshom bral ba'i nyams len drag po yis// legs par nyams longs sgom 'di'i srol thob dang*// khyed rnams 'dod 'bras gdod ma'i mgon po mchog

/lhan skyes ye shes chos sku'i rol pa de// tshe 'dir rtogs shing de yi rang mdangs rtsal| |nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// zung 'jug yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bar do'i skad cig dang por cis mi thob// de ltar de brtsams pa las ni// byung ba'i dge ba gang mchis des// yon tan du ma'i dpal yon can// zung 'jug zab gsal snying po'i dpyid// nges par 'dom mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// gar gyi dbang po gang khyod nyid// gang du 'khod pa'i seṅge'i khri// yod med mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam// don dam zung 'jug bde chen por// bdag kyang myur du cis mi 'jug /de ltar rtsa 'dab snyan brgyud kyi khrid yig dang las phran bu'i skor gyi gdams pa gcig tu dril ba dad ldan slob ma rnams kyi re skong yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di/ sngon chad yig cha tshan pa mang ba zhig 'thor 'dug pa dang don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor byas te/ yul dbur stod 'bri gung du skyes pa shākya'i dge slong lam 'di nyid la yang dang yang du sbyangs pa lhan skyes ye shes kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa don gyi rnal 'byor pa/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ lcags pho spre'u'i lo sa ga zla ba'i nyer bdun gyi dus khyad par can la/ mdo khams stod kyi sa'i thig le sgrub brgyud dam pa 'bri gung pa'i gdan sa byang chub kyi gling gnyis pa/ zla kun dga' tshal gyi chos grwa yangs pa'i dbus dpal rnam gnon tshul khrims kyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i yang thog tu sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //shu bhaṃ stu sarba dza ga taṃ/ zab chos 'di'i srung ma ni dpal mgon tsa turmu kha kho na yin pa paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa sogs kyis gsungs pas khrid yig 'di 'chad pa'i tshe mgon po zhal bzhi pa la gtor ma 'bul ba gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
